// src/modules/auth/services/step-up.service.ts
var StepUpService = class {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
  }
  async verify(input) {
    switch (input.method) {
      case "password":
        await this.#verifyPassword(input);
        break;
      case "totp":
        await this.#verifyTotp(input);
        break;
      case "passkey":
        await this.#verifyPasskey(input);
        break;
      default:
        throw ApiError.badRequest("Unsupported step-up method");
    }
    const elevatedAt = /* @__PURE__ */ new Date();
    const { count } = await this.db.session.updateMany({
      where: {
        id: input.sessionId,
        identityId: input.identityId,
        // ownership re-check at write time
        valid: true,
        expiresAt: { gt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() }
      },
      data: {
        authLevel: "aal2",
        elevatedAt
      }
    });
    if (count === 0) {
      throw ApiError.forbidden(
        "Session expired or was revoked during step-up \u2014 please log in again"
      );
    }
  }
  // ── Private verifiers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Each verifier only reads — no mutations. All mutations are in verify() above.
  async #verifyPassword(input) {
    if (!input.password) {
      throw ApiError.badRequest(
        "password is required for step-up method 'password'"
      );
    }
    const localAccount = await this.db.localAccount.findUnique({
      where: { identityId: input.identityId },
      select: { passwordHash: true }
    });
    if (!localAccount) {
      throw ApiError.badRequest(
        "No local account found \u2014 use a different step-up method"
      );
    }
    const valid = await verifyPassword(
      localAccount.passwordHash,
      input.password
    );
    if (!valid) {
      throw ApiError.unauthorized("Incorrect password");
    }
  }
  async #verifyTotp(input) {
    if (!input.totpCode) {
      throw ApiError.badRequest(
        "totpCode is required for step-up method 'totp'"
      );
    }
    const mfa = await this.db.mfa.findFirst({
      where: { identityId: input.identityId, type: "TOTP", enabled: true },
      select: { secret: true }
    });
    if (!mfa?.secret) {
      throw ApiError.badRequest("No active TOTP MFA configuration found");
    }
    const mfaService = new MfaService(this.db);
    const verified = mfaService.verifyTotp(mfa.secret, input.totpCode);
    if (!verified) {
      throw ApiError.unauthorized("Invalid TOTP code");
    }
  }
  async #verifyPasskey(input) {
    if (!input.passkeyResponse || !input.passkeyChallengeId) {
      throw ApiError.badRequest(
        "passkeyResponse and passkeyChallengeId are required for step-up method 'passkey'"
      );
    }
    const stored = await consumeChallenge(input.identityId, "authentication");
    if (!stored) {
      throw ApiError.badRequest(
        "Step-up passkey challenge not found or expired \u2014 call /passkey/options/authenticate first"
      );
    }
    if (stored.challengeId !== input.passkeyChallengeId) {
      throw ApiError.badRequest(
        "passkeyChallengeId mismatch \u2014 challenge does not match the issued options"
      );
    }
    const passkeyService = new PasskeyService(this.db);
    const { verified } = await passkeyService.verifyAuthentication(
      input.passkeyResponse,
      stored.challenge
      // ← server-retrieved, not client-provided
    );
    if (!verified) {
      throw ApiError.unauthorized("Passkey step-up verification failed");
    }
  }
};

// src/modules/auth/routes/step-up.route.ts
var StepUpBodySchema = z23.discriminatedUnion("method", [
  z23.object({
    method: z23.literal("password"),
    sessionId: z23.string().min(40).max(128),
    password: z23.string().min(1)
  }),
  z23.object({
    method: z23.literal("totp"),
    sessionId: z23.string().min(40).max(128),
    totpCode: z23.string().length(6)
  }),
  z23.object({
    method: z23.literal("passkey"),
    sessionId: z23.string().min(40).max(128),
    passkeyResponse: z23.record(z23.string(), z23.unknown()),
    passkeyChallengeId: z23.string().uuid()
  })
]);
async function stepUpRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.post(
    "/step-up",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      config: { rateLimit: { max: 5, timeWindow: "5 minutes" } },
      schema: {
        tags: ["Authentication"],
        summary: "Re-authenticate to elevate the current session for privileged operations",
        description: "Call this when a route returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED. Elevates the session for 15 minutes. Supported methods: password, totp, passkey.",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        body: StepUpBodySchema,
        response: {
          200: z23.object({
            success: z23.literal(true),
            elevatedUntil: z23.string().describe("ISO-8601 timestamp when elevation expires")
          })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const body2 = req.body;
      const identityId = req.identity.id;
      const session = await fastify.db.session.findFirst({
        where: {
          id: body2.sessionId,
          identityId,
          valid: true,
          expiresAt: { gt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() }
        },
        select: { id: true }
      });
      if (!session) {
        throw ApiError.forbidden("Session not found or does not belong to you");
      }
      const stepUpService = new StepUpService(fastify.db);
      await stepUpService.verify({
        sessionId: body2.sessionId,
        identityId,
        method: body2.method,
        password: "password" in body2 ? body2.password : void 0,
        totpCode: "totpCode" in body2 ? body2.totpCode : void 0,
        passkeyResponse: "passkeyResponse" in body2 ? body2.passkeyResponse : void 0,
        passkeyChallengeId: "passkeyChallengeId" in body2 ? body2.passkeyChallengeId : void 0
      });
      void auditService.log({
        action: "SESSION_ELEVATED",
        identityId,
        ip: req.ip,
        metadata: { stepUpMethod: body2.method, sessionId: body2.sessionId }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      const elevatedUntil = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1e3).toISOString();
      return reply.send({ success: true, elevatedUntil });
    }
  );
}

// src/modules/auth/flows/set-username.flow.ts
var setUsernameFlow = {
  name: "auth:set-username",
  inputSchema: SetUsernameSchema,
  async execute(input, ctx) {
    if (!ctx.identityId) {
      throw ApiError.unauthorized("Authentication required");
    }
    const identityRepo = new IdentityRepository(ctx.db);
    if (await identityRepo.isUsernameTaken(input.username, ctx.identityId)) {
      throw ApiError.conflict("That username is already taken");
    }
    let identity;
    try {
      identity = await identityRepo.setUsername(ctx.identityId, input.username);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err?.code === "P2002") {
        throw ApiError.conflict("That username is already taken");
      }
      throw err;
    }
    await auditService.log(
      { action: "USERNAME_SET", identityId: ctx.identityId, ip: ctx.ip },
      ctx.db
    );
    return { identity: presentIdentity(identity) };
  }
};

// src/modules/auth/routes/set-username.route.ts
async function setUsernameRoute(fastify) {
  const app = fastify.withTypeProvider();
  app.patch(
    "/username",
    {
      schema: {
        body: SetUsernameSchema,
        tags: ["auth"],
        summary: "Set or update the authenticated user's username"
      },
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser
    },
    async (request, reply) => {
      const result = await flowExecutor.run(setUsernameFlow, request.body, {
        identityId: request.identity.id,
        tenantId: request.identity.tenantId,
        ip: request.ip
      });
      return reply.code(200).send(result);
    }
  );
}

// src/modules/oauth/validators/oauth.schemas.ts
import { z as z24 } from "zod";
var AuthorizeQuerySchema = z24.object({
  response_type: z24.literal("code"),
  client_id: z24.string(),
  redirect_uri: z24.string().url(),
  scope: z24.string().optional().default("openid profile email"),
  state: z24.string().optional(),
  nonce: z24.string().optional(),
  code_challenge: z24.string().optional(),
  code_challenge_method: z24.enum(["S256", "plain"]).optional(),
  // ── OIDC Core 1.0 §3.1.2.1 ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  //
  // prompt — controls whether the authorization server prompts the end-user
  //   for reauthentication or consent.
  //
  //   "none"          — do not display any auth/consent UI. Return
  //                     login_required or consent_required if interaction
  //                     is needed. Used for silent token renewal.
  //   "login"         — force re-authentication even if the user has a valid
  //                     session. Returns interaction_required if the server
  //                     cannot force this inline (which is our case for the
  //                     API flow — we redirect the client back to /login).
  //   "consent"       — force the consent screen even if the user already
  //                     granted consent. Useful when scopes change.
  //   "select_account"— ask the user to select an account. We treat this the
  //                     same as "login" since we don't support multi-account.
  //
  // max_age — maximum authentication age in seconds (RFC 6749 + OIDC Core §3.1.2.1).
  //   If the user's session is older than max_age seconds, the server MUST
  //   reauthenticate the user (or return interaction_required).
  //   A value of 0 means "must re-authenticate now" — equivalent to prompt=login.
  prompt: z24.enum(["none", "login", "consent", "select_account"]).optional(),
  max_age: z24.preprocess(
    (v) => v !== void 0 && v !== "" ? Number(v) : void 0,
    z24.number().int().nonnegative().optional()
  )
});
var TokenExchangeSchema = z24.discriminatedUnion("grant_type", [
  z24.object({
    grant_type: z24.literal("authorization_code"),
    code: z24.string(),
    redirect_uri: z24.string().url(),
    client_id: z24.string(),
    client_secret: z24.string().optional(),
    code_verifier: z24.string().optional(),
    state: z24.string().optional()
  }),
  z24.object({
    grant_type: z24.literal("refresh_token"),
    refresh_token: z24.string(),
    client_id: z24.string(),
    client_secret: z24.string().optional()
  }),
  z24.object({
    grant_type: z24.literal("client_credentials"),
    client_id: z24.string(),
    client_secret: z24.string(),
    scope: z24.string().optional()
  })
]);
var IntrospectSchema = z24.object({
  token: z24.string(),
  token_type_hint: z24.enum(["access_token", "refresh_token"]).optional()
});
var RevokeSchema = z24.object({
  token: z24.string(),
  token_type_hint: z24.enum(["access_token", "refresh_token"]).optional()
});

// src/modules/oauth/repositories/client.repository.ts
init_api_error();
var ClientRepository = class {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
  }
  async findByClientId(clientId, tenantId) {
    if (tenantId) {
      return this.db.client.findFirst({
        where: {
          clientId,
          OR: [{ tenantId }, { tenantId: null }]
        },
        // Exact tenant match takes precedence if both exist
        orderBy: { tenantId: "desc" },
        include: { redirectUris: true }
      });
    }
    return this.db.client.findFirst({
      where: { clientId },
      include: { redirectUris: true }
    });
  }
  async findByClientIdOrThrow(clientId, tenantId) {
    const client = await this.findByClientId(clientId, tenantId);
    if (!client) throw ApiError.invalidClient();
    return client;
  }
  async validateRedirectUri(clientId, redirectUri) {
    const count = await this.db.clientRedirectUri.count({
      where: { clientId, uri: redirectUri }
    });
    return count > 0;
  }
};

// src/modules/oauth/services/consent.service.ts
var ConsentService = class {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
  }
  async hasConsent(identityId, clientId, requestedScopes) {
    const consent = await this.db.oAuthConsent.findFirst({
      where: { identityId, clientId, revokedAt: null }
    });
    if (!consent) return false;
    const granted = consent.scopes;
    return requestedScopes.every((s) => granted.includes(s));
  }
  async grant(identityId, clientId, scopes) {
    const existing = await this.db.oAuthConsent.findFirst({
      where: { identityId, clientId }
    });
    if (existing) {
      return this.db.oAuthConsent.update({
        where: { id: existing.id },
        data: { scopes, revokedAt: null, grantedAt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() }
      });
    }
    return this.db.oAuthConsent.create({
      data: { identityId, clientId, scopes }
    });
  }
  async revoke(identityId, clientId) {
    return this.db.oAuthConsent.updateMany({
      where: { identityId, clientId },
      data: { revokedAt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() }
    });
  }
};

// src/modules/oauth/flows/authorize.flow.ts
init_crypto2();
init_api_error();
import { addMinutes as addMinutes3 } from "date-fns";
var authorizeFlow = {
  name: "oauth:authorize",
  inputSchema: AuthorizeQuerySchema,
  async execute(input, ctx) {
    if (!ctx.identityId)
      throw ApiError.unauthorized("Must be authenticated to authorize");
    const clientRepo = new ClientRepository(ctx.db);
    const consentService = new ConsentService(ctx.db);
    const client = await clientRepo.findByClientIdOrThrow(
      input.client_id,
      ctx.tenantId
    );
    const uriValid = await clientRepo.validateRedirectUri(
      client.id,
      input.redirect_uri
    );
    if (!uriValid)
      throw ApiError.invalidRequest(
        "redirect_uri is not registered for this client"
      );
    if (client.requirePkce && !input.code_challenge) {
      throw ApiError.invalidRequest(
        "code_challenge is required for this client (PKCE is mandatory)"
      );
    }
    const isPromptNone = input.prompt === "none";
    const needsFreshnessCheck = input.prompt === "login" || input.prompt === "select_account" || input.max_age !== void 0;
    if (needsFreshnessCheck) {
      const session = await ctx.db.session.findFirst({
        where: {
          identityId: ctx.identityId,
          valid: true,
          expiresAt: { gt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() }
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        select: { createdAt: true, authLevel: true }
      });
      const needsReauth = (() => {
        if (input.prompt === "login" || input.prompt === "select_account") {
          return true;
        }
        if (input.max_age !== void 0 && session) {
          const sessionAgeSecs = (Date.now() - session.createdAt.getTime()) / 1e3;
          return sessionAgeSecs > input.max_age;
        }
        if (input.max_age === 0) return true;
        return false;
      })();
      if (needsReauth) {
        if (isPromptNone) {
          throw Object.assign(
            ApiError.badRequest(
              "User must re-authenticate \u2014 prompt=none prevents this"
            ),
            { code: "login_required" }
          );
        }
        throw Object.assign(
          ApiError.badRequest(
            "Session is too old or prompt=login was requested \u2014 user must re-authenticate"
          ),
          { code: "interaction_required" }
        );
      }
    }
    const rawScope = input.scope;
    const requestedScopes = rawScope ? rawScope.split(" ") : client.scopes;
    const forceConsent = input.prompt === "consent";
    const hasConsent = forceConsent ? false : await consentService.hasConsent(
      ctx.identityId,
      client.id,
      requestedScopes
    );
    if (!hasConsent) {
      if (isPromptNone) {
        throw Object.assign(
          ApiError.badRequest("Consent required \u2014 prompt=none prevents this"),
          { code: "consent_required" }
        );
      }
      return {
        consentRequired: true,
        clientName: client.name,
        scopes: requestedScopes
      };
    }
    const code = generateToken(32);
    await ctx.db.authorizationCode.create({
      data: {
        code,
        clientId: client.id,
        identityId: ctx.identityId,
        redirectUri: input.redirect_uri,
        scopes: requestedScopes,
        nonce: input.nonce,
        state: input.state,
        codeChallenge: input.code_challenge,
        codeChallengeMethod: input.code_challenge_method,
        expiresAt: addMinutes3(/* @__PURE__ */ new Date(), 5)
      }
    });
    return { code, state: input.state, consentRequired: false };
  }
};

// src/modules/oauth/routes/authorize.route.ts
import { z as z25 } from "zod";
async function authorizeRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.get(
    "/authorize",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Protocol"],
        summary: "OAuth2 authorization endpoint",
        description: [
          "Issues an authorization code for a registered OAuth client.",
          "",
          "**PKCE:** Required for all public clients (`requirePkce: true`).",
          "",
          "**prompt parameter:**",
          "- `none` \u2014 do not show any UI; return `login_required` or `consent_required` if interaction is needed",
          "- `login` \u2014 force re-authentication even with a valid session",
          "- `consent` \u2014 force the consent screen regardless of existing grants",
          "- `select_account` \u2014 treated as `login` (multi-account not supported)",
          "",
          "**max_age:** If the current session is older than `max_age` seconds, returns `interaction_required`."
        ].join("\n"),
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        querystring: z25.object({
          client_id: z25.string().min(1),
          response_type: z25.string().default("code"),
          redirect_uri: z25.string().url(),
          scope: z25.string().optional(),
          state: z25.string().optional(),
          nonce: z25.string().optional(),
          code_challenge: z25.string().optional(),
          code_challenge_method: z25.enum(["S256", "plain"]).default("S256"),
          // OIDC Core prompt and max_age
          prompt: z25.enum(["none", "login", "consent", "select_account"]).optional(),
          max_age: z25.coerce.number().int().nonnegative().optional()
        }),
        response: {
          200: z25.object({ success: z25.boolean(), data: z25.any() }),
          400: z25.object({
            success: z25.boolean(),
            error: z25.string(),
            code: z25.string().optional()
            // OIDC error code e.g. "login_required"
          })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const result = await flowExecutor.run(
        authorizeFlow,
        req.query,
        {
          identityId: req.identity.id,
          tenantId: req.identity.tenantId,
          ip: req.ip
        },
        { transaction: false }
      );
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: result });
    }
  );
}

// src/modules/oauth/services/pkce.service.ts
import { createHash as createHash3 } from "crypto";
function verifyPkce(verifier, challenge, method) {
  if (method === "S256") {
    const computed = createHash3("sha256").update(verifier).digest("base64url");
    return computed === challenge;
  }
  return verifier === challenge;
}

// src/modules/oauth/flows/token-exchange.flow.ts
init_api_error();
import argon22 from "argon2";
var tokenExchangeFlow = {
  name: "oauth:token-exchange",
  inputSchema: TokenExchangeSchema,
  async execute(input, ctx) {
    const clientRepo = new ClientRepository(ctx.db);
    const tokenService = new TokenService();
    if (input.grant_type === "authorization_code") {
      const authCode = await ctx.db.authorizationCode.findFirst({
        where: {
          code: input.code,
          consumed: false,
          expiresAt: { gt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() }
        },
        include: { client: { include: { redirectUris: true } } }
      });
      if (!authCode)
        throw ApiError.invalidGrant("Authorization code is invalid or expired");
      if (authCode.client.clientId !== input.client_id)
        throw ApiError.invalidClient("client_id mismatch");
      if (input.redirect_uri) {
        const allowed = authCode.client.redirectUris.some(
          (r) => r.uri === input.redirect_uri
        );
        if (!allowed)
          throw ApiError.invalidRequest(
            "redirect_uri does not match registered URIs"
          );
      }
      if (!authCode.client.public && authCode.client.clientSecret) {
        if (!input.client_secret)
          throw ApiError.invalidClient("client_secret required");
        const valid = await argon22.verify(
          authCode.client.clientSecret,
          input.client_secret
        );
        if (!valid) throw ApiError.invalidClient("Invalid client_secret");
      }
      if (authCode.client.requirePkce && !authCode.codeChallenge) {
        throw ApiError.invalidGrant(
          "PKCE is required for this client but no code_challenge was recorded"
        );
      }
      if (authCode.codeChallenge) {
        if (!input.code_verifier)
          throw ApiError.invalidRequest("code_verifier required");
        const ok = verifyPkce(
          input.code_verifier,
          authCode.codeChallenge,
          authCode.codeChallengeMethod ?? "S256"
        );
        if (!ok) throw ApiError.invalidGrant("PKCE verification failed");
      }
      if (authCode.state !== null && authCode.state !== void 0) {
        if (input.state !== authCode.state) {
          throw ApiError.invalidRequest(
            "state mismatch \u2014 the value sent at token exchange must match the value sent at authorization"
          );
        }
      }
      await ctx.db.authorizationCode.update({
        where: { id: authCode.id },
        data: { consumed: true }
      });
      const session = await ctx.db.session.findFirst({
        where: { identityId: authCode.identityId, valid: true },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        select: { id: true, authLevel: true }
      });
      if (!session) {
        throw ApiError.invalidGrant(
          "No active session found for this identity \u2014 please log in again"
        );
      }
      const sessionId = session.id;
      const bundle = await tokenService.issue(ctx, {
        identityId: authCode.identityId,
        clientId: authCode.clientId,
        sessionId,
        scopes: authCode.scopes,
        audience: [authCode.client.clientId],
        tenantId: ctx.tenantId,
        nonce: authCode.nonce ?? void 0,
        authLevel: session.authLevel ?? "aal1"
      });
      void auditService.log({
        action: "SESSION_CREATED",
        identityId: authCode.identityId,
        ip: ctx.ip
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      return presentTokenResponse(bundle);
    }
    if (input.grant_type === "client_credentials") {
      const client = await clientRepo.findByClientIdOrThrow(
        input.client_id,
        ctx.tenantId
      );
      if (!client.clientSecret)
        throw ApiError.invalidClient(
          "Client does not support client_credentials"
        );
      const valid = await argon22.verify(
        client.clientSecret,
        input.client_secret
      );
      if (!valid) throw ApiError.invalidClient("Invalid client_secret");
      const requestedScopes = input.scope ? input.scope.split(" ") : client.scopes;
      const disallowedScopes = requestedScopes.filter(
        (s) => ["openid", "offline_access"].includes(s)
      );
      if (disallowedScopes.length > 0) {
        throw ApiError.invalidScope(
          `client_credentials does not support: ${disallowedScopes.join(", ")}`
        );
      }
      const bundle = await tokenService.issue(ctx, {
        identityId: client.id,
        clientId: client.id,
        sessionId: client.id,
        scopes: requestedScopes,
        audience: [client.clientId],
        tenantId: ctx.tenantId
      });
      return presentTokenResponse(bundle);
    }
    throw ApiError.unsupportedGrantType();
  }
};

// src/modules/oauth/flows/token-refresh.flow.ts
import { z as z26 } from "zod";
init_api_error();
var RefreshSchema = z26.object({
  refresh_token: z26.string(),
  client_id: z26.string(),
  client_secret: z26.string().optional()
});
var tokenRefreshFlow = {
  name: "oauth:token-refresh",
  inputSchema: RefreshSchema,
  async execute(input, ctx) {
    const tokenService = new TokenService();
    const existing = await ctx.db.refreshToken.findFirst({
      where: { token: input.refresh_token },
      select: {
        id: true,
        jti: true,
        familyId: true,
        revoked: true,
        expiresAt: true,
        clientId: true,
        identityId: true,
        sessionId: true
      }
    });
    if (!existing) {
      void auditService.log({
        action: "TOKEN_REVOKED",
        ip: ctx.ip,
        metadata: { reason: "refresh_token_not_found" }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      throw ApiError.invalidGrant("Refresh token is invalid");
    }
    if (existing.expiresAt <= /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() && !existing.revoked) {
      throw ApiError.invalidGrant(
        "Refresh token has expired \u2014 please log in again"
      );
    }
    if (existing.revoked) {
      await triggerKillChain(ctx, input.refresh_token, existing);
    }
    const identity = await ctx.db.identity.findUnique({
      where: { id: existing.identityId },
      select: { status: true }
    });
    if (!identity || identity.status === "DELETED") {
      throw ApiError.invalidGrant("Identity no longer exists");
    }
    if (identity.status === "SUSPENDED") {
      throw ApiError.forbidden("Account suspended");
    }
    if (identity.status === "BANNED") {
      throw ApiError.forbidden("Account banned");
    }
    const clientRecord = await ctx.db.client.findUnique({
      where: { id: existing.clientId },
      select: { clientId: true, scopes: true }
    });
    if (!clientRecord) {
      throw ApiError.invalidGrant(
        "Client associated with this token no longer exists"
      );
    }
    const lastAccessToken = await ctx.db.accessToken.findFirst({
      where: {
        identityId: existing.identityId,
        clientId: existing.clientId,
        revoked: false
      },
      orderBy: { issuedAt: "desc" },
      select: { scopes: true }
    });
    const scopes = lastAccessToken?.scopes ?? clientRecord.scopes ?? [
      "openid",
      "profile",
      "email",
      "offline_access"
    ];
    const { count: revokedCount } = await ctx.db.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: {
        id: existing.id,
        revoked: false
        // ← atomic guard against race
      },
      data: {
        revoked: true,
        rotatedAt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date()
      }
    });
    if (revokedCount === 0) {
      await triggerKillChain(ctx, input.refresh_token, existing);
    }
    const currentSession = existing.sessionId ? await ctx.db.session.findUnique({
      where: { id: existing.sessionId },
      select: { authLevel: true }
    }) : null;
    const bundle = await tokenService.issue(ctx, {
      identityId: existing.identityId,
      clientId: clientRecord.clientId,
      sessionId: existing.sessionId ?? existing.id,
      scopes,
      audience: [clientRecord.clientId],
      tenantId: ctx.tenantId,
      familyId: existing.familyId,
      // inherit parent's family
      parentJti: existing.jti,
      // record lineage
      authLevel: currentSession?.authLevel
    });
    return presentTokenResponse(bundle);
  }
};
async function triggerKillChain(ctx, rawToken, existing) {
  const sessionId = existing?.sessionId;
  const familyId = existing?.familyId;
  const identityId = existing?.identityId;
  const clientId = existing?.clientId;
  if (familyId) {
    await Promise.all([
      ctx.db.refreshToken.updateMany({
        where: { familyId },
        data: { revoked: true }
      }),
      sessionId ? ctx.db.session.updateMany({
        where: { id: sessionId },
        data: { valid: false }
      }) : Promise.resolve()
    ]);
  } else if (sessionId) {
    await Promise.all([
      ctx.db.refreshToken.updateMany({
        where: { sessionId },
        data: { revoked: true }
      }),
      ctx.db.session.updateMany({
        where: { id: sessionId },
        data: { valid: false }
      })
    ]);
  } else if (existing?.id) {
    await ctx.db.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { id: existing.id },
      data: { revoked: true }
    });
  } else {
    const anyToken = await ctx.db.refreshToken.findFirst({
      where: { token: rawToken },
      select: {
        sessionId: true,
        familyId: true,
        identityId: true,
        clientId: true
      }
    });
    if (anyToken) {
      await Promise.all([
        anyToken.familyId ? ctx.db.refreshToken.updateMany({
          where: { familyId: anyToken.familyId },
          data: { revoked: true }
        }) : Promise.resolve(),
        anyToken.sessionId ? ctx.db.session.updateMany({
          where: { id: anyToken.sessionId },
          data: { valid: false }
        }) : Promise.resolve()
      ]);
      await blocklistLiveAccessTokens(
        ctx,
        anyToken.identityId,
        anyToken.clientId
      );
    }
  }
  if (identityId && clientId) {
    await blocklistLiveAccessTokens(ctx, identityId, clientId);
  }
  void auditService.log({
    action: "TOKEN_REVOKED",
    ip: ctx.ip,
    metadata: { reason: "replay_or_race_detected" }
  }).catch(() => {
  });
  throw ApiError.invalidGrant(
    "Refresh token is invalid, expired, or already used"
  );
}
async function blocklistLiveAccessTokens(ctx, identityId, clientId) {
  const liveTokens = await ctx.db.accessToken.findMany({
    where: {
      identityId,
      clientId,
      revoked: false,
      expiresAt: { gt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() }
    },
    select: { id: true, jti: true, expiresAt: true }
  });
  if (liveTokens.length === 0) return;
  await ctx.db.accessToken.updateMany({
    where: { id: { in: liveTokens.map((t) => t.id) } },
    data: { revoked: true }
  });
  for (const t of liveTokens) {
    if (!t.jti) continue;
    const remainingTtlMs = t.expiresAt.getTime() - Date.now();
    const remainingTtlSec = Math.max(Math.ceil(remainingTtlMs / 1e3), 1);
    void blockJti(t.jti, remainingTtlSec).catch(() => {
    });
    void ctx.db.revokedJti.create({ data: { jti: t.jti, expiresAt: t.expiresAt } }).catch(() => {
    });
  }
}

// src/modules/oauth/flows/revoke-token-by-id.flow.ts
import { z as z27 } from "zod";
var RevokeTokenByIdSchema = z27.object({
  id: z27.string().cuid()
});
var revokeTokenByIdFlow = {
  name: "oauth:token-revoke-by-id",
  inputSchema: RevokeTokenByIdSchema,
  async execute(input, ctx) {
    if (!ctx.identityId) throw ApiError.unauthorized("Not logged in");
    const accessToken = await ctx.db.accessToken.findFirst({
      where: { id: input.id, identityId: ctx.identityId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        jti: true,
        identityId: true,
        expiresAt: true,
        revoked: true
      }
    });
    if (!accessToken) {
      throw ApiError.notFound("Token not found");
    }
    if (accessToken.revoked) {
      return {};
    }
    await ctx.db.accessToken.update({
      where: { id: accessToken.id },
      data: { revoked: true }
    });
    if (accessToken.jti) {
      const remainingTtlMs = accessToken.expiresAt.getTime() - Date.now();
      const remainingTtlSec = Math.max(Math.ceil(remainingTtlMs / 1e3), 1);
      void blockJti(accessToken.jti, remainingTtlSec).catch(() => {
      });
      void ctx.db.revokedJti.create({
        data: {
          jti: accessToken.jti,
          expiresAt: accessToken.expiresAt
        }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
    }
    void auditService.log({
      action: "TOKEN_REVOKED",
      identityId: accessToken.identityId,
      ip: ctx.ip,
      metadata: {
        reason: "user_revoked_active_token",
        tokenId: accessToken.id
      }
    }).catch(() => {
    });
    return {};
  }
};

import { z as z29 } from "zod";
async function tokensRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.post(
    "/token",
    {
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth2 / OIDC Server"],
        summary: "Issue tokens via standard grant execution sequences",
        body: z29.object({
          grant_type: z29.string(),
          code: z29.string().optional(),
          redirect_uri: z29.string().url().optional(),
          client_id: z29.string().optional(),
          client_secret: z29.string().optional(),
          refresh_token: z29.string().optional(),
          code_verifier: z29.string().optional()
        }),
        response: {
          200: z29.record(z29.string(), z29.any())
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const body2 = req.body;
      let result;
      if (body2?.grant_type === "refresh_token") {
        result = await flowExecutor.run(tokenRefreshFlow, body2, {
          tenantId: null,
          ip: req.ip
        });
      } else {
        result = await flowExecutor.run(tokenExchangeFlow, body2, {
          tenantId: null,
          ip: req.ip
        });
      }
      return reply.send(presentTokenResponse(result));
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/tokens",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth2 / OIDC Server"],
        summary: "List the caller's active access tokens",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        response: {
          200: z29.object({ success: z29.boolean(), data: z29.array(z29.any()) })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const tokens2 = await fastify.db.accessToken.findMany({
        where: {
          identityId: req.identity.id,
          revoked: false,
          expiresAt: { gt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() }
        },
        include: { client: { select: { name: true } } },
        orderBy: { issuedAt: "desc" }
      });
      return reply.send({
        success: true,
        data: tokens2.map(presentActiveToken)
      });
    }
  );
  fastify.delete(
    "/tokens/:id",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth2 / OIDC Server"],
        summary: "Revoke one of the caller's active access tokens by id",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: z29.object({ id: z29.string().cuid() }),
        response: {
          200: z29.object({ success: z29.boolean() }),
          404: commonErrorSchema
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { id } = req.params;
      await flowExecutor.run(
        revokeTokenByIdFlow,
        { id },
        {
          identityId: req.identity.id,
          tenantId: null,
          ip: req.ip
        }
      );
      return reply.send({ success: true });
    }
  );

// src/modules/oauth/routes/introspect.route.ts
import { z as z30 } from "zod";
async function introspectRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.post(
    "/introspect",
    {
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth2 / OIDC Server"],
        summary: "RFC 7662 Token Introspection tracking verification",
        body: IntrospectSchema,
        response: {
          200: z30.object({
            active: z30.boolean(),
            scope: z30.string().optional(),
            client_id: z30.string().optional(),
            sub: z30.string().optional(),
            aud: z30.string().optional(),
            iat: z30.number().optional(),
            exp: z30.number().optional(),
            jti: z30.string().optional(),
            token_type: z30.string().optional()
          }),
          401: z30.object({ active: z30.literal(false) })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const body2 = IntrospectSchema.parse(req.body);
      const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
      if (!authHeader?.startsWith("Basic ")) {
        return reply.status(401).send({ active: false });
      }
      const accessToken = await fastify.db.accessToken.findFirst({
        where: { token: body2.token, revoked: false },
        include: { identity: true, client: true }
      });
      if (accessToken) {
        const active = accessToken.expiresAt > /* @__PURE__ */ new Date();
        if (!active) return reply.send({ active: false });
        if (accessToken.jti) {
          const revoked = await fastify.db.revokedJti.findUnique({
            where: { jti: accessToken.jti }
          });
          if (revoked) return reply.send({ active: false });
        }
        return reply.send({
          active: true,
          scope: accessToken.scopes.join(" "),
          client_id: accessToken.client.clientId,
          sub: accessToken.identityId,
          aud: accessToken.audience,
          iat: Math.floor(accessToken.issuedAt.getTime() / 1e3),
          exp: Math.floor(accessToken.expiresAt.getTime() / 1e3),
          jti: accessToken.jti,
          token_type: "Bearer"
        });
      }
      const refreshToken = await fastify.db.refreshToken.findFirst({
        where: { token: body2.token, revoked: false }
      });
      if (refreshToken) {
        const active = refreshToken.expiresAt > /* @__PURE__ */ new Date();
        return reply.send({ active, token_type: "refresh_token" });
      }
      return reply.send({ active: false });
    }
  );
}

// src/modules/oauth/flows/token-revoke.flow.ts
var tokenRevokeFlow = {
  name: "oauth:token-revoke",
  inputSchema: RevokeSchema,
  async execute(input, ctx) {
    const ownerFilter = ctx.identityId ? { identityId: ctx.identityId } : {};
    const accessToken = await ctx.db.accessToken.findFirst({
      where: { token: input.token, ...ownerFilter },
      select: { id: true, jti: true, identityId: true, expiresAt: true }
    });
    if (accessToken) {
      await ctx.db.accessToken.update({
        where: { id: accessToken.id },
        data: { revoked: true }
      });
      if (accessToken.jti) {
        const remainingTtlMs = accessToken.expiresAt.getTime() - Date.now();
        const remainingTtlSec = Math.max(Math.ceil(remainingTtlMs / 1e3), 1);
        void blockJti(accessToken.jti, remainingTtlSec).catch(() => {
        });
        void ctx.db.revokedJti.create({
          data: {
            jti: accessToken.jti,
            expiresAt: accessToken.expiresAt
          }
        }).catch(() => {
        });
      }
      void auditService.log({
        action: "TOKEN_REVOKED",
        identityId: accessToken.identityId,
        ip: ctx.ip
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      return {};
    }
    const refreshToken = await ctx.db.refreshToken.findFirst({
      where: { token: input.token, ...ownerFilter },
      select: { id: true, identityId: true }
    });
    if (refreshToken) {
      await ctx.db.refreshToken.update({
        where: { id: refreshToken.id },
        data: { revoked: true }
      });
      void auditService.log({
        action: "TOKEN_REVOKED",
        identityId: refreshToken.identityId,
        ip: ctx.ip
      }).catch(() => {
      });
    }
    return {};
  }
};

// src/modules/oauth/routes/jwks.route.ts
import { exportJWK, importSPKI as importSPKI2 } from "jose";
import { z as z33 } from "zod";
async function jwksRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.get(
    "/jwks",
    {
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth2 / OIDC Server"],
        summary: "RFC 7517 JSON Web Key Set \u2014 global signing keys",
        response: {
          200: z33.object({ keys: z33.array(z33.record(z33.string(), z33.any())) })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const keys = await fastify.db.tenantSigningKey.findMany({
        where: { status: "ACTIVE" }
        // ← was isActive: true
      });
      const jwks = await Promise.all(
        keys.map(
          async (key) => {
            try {
              const pem = `-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
${Buffer.from(key.publicKey).toString("base64")}
-----END PUBLIC KEY-----`;
              const cryptoKey = await importSPKI2(pem, key.algorithm);
              const jwk = await exportJWK(cryptoKey);
              return { ...jwk, kid: key.kid, alg: key.algorithm, use: "sig" };
            } catch {
              return null;
            }
          }
        )
      );
      return reply.send({ keys: jwks.filter(Boolean) });
    }
  );
}

// src/modules/oauth/routes/clients.route.ts
import { z as z34 } from "zod";
init_crypto2();
var CreateClientSchema = z34.object({
  name: z34.string().min(1),
  grantTypes: z34.array(
    z34.enum(["authorization_code", "refresh_token", "client_credentials"])
  ).default(["authorization_code", "refresh_token"]),
  scopes: z34.array(z34.string()).default(["openid", "profile", "email"]),
  redirectUris: z34.array(z34.string().url()).default([]),
  public: z34.boolean().default(false),
  requirePkce: z34.boolean().default(true),
  tenantId: z34.string().cuid().optional(),
  projectId: z34.string().cuid().optional(),
  // ← NEW
  logoUri: z34.string().url().optional(),
  tosUri: z34.string().url().optional(),
  policyUri: z34.string().url().optional()
});
async function assertProjectBelongsToTenant(fastify, projectId, targetTenantId) {
  const project = await fastify.db.project.findFirst({
    where: { id: projectId, tenantId: targetTenantId },
    select: { id: true }
  });
  if (!project) {
    throw ApiError.badRequest(
      "projectId does not exist or does not belong to this tenant"
    );
  }
}
async function clientsRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.post(
    "/clients",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth2 / OIDC Server"],
        summary: "Register an OAuth application client \u2014 requires PRO plan + ADMIN role (PRO)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        body: CreateClientSchema,
        response: {
          201: z34.object({
            success: z34.boolean(),
            data: z34.object({
              clientId: z34.string(),
              clientSecret: z34.string().nullable(),
              name: z34.string(),
              projectId: z34.string().nullable(),
              grantTypes: z34.array(z34.string()),
              scopes: z34.array(z34.string()),
              redirectUris: z34.array(z34.string()),
              public: z34.boolean(),
              requirePkce: z34.boolean()
            })
          })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const input = CreateClientSchema.parse(req.body);
      const targetTenantId = input.tenantId ?? req.identity.tenantId ?? "SYSTEM";
      if (!await hasPermission(
        fastify.db,
        req.identity.id,
        targetTenantId,
        "client:create"
      )) {
        throw ApiError.forbidden("Permission required: client:create");
      }
      if (input.projectId) {
        await assertProjectBelongsToTenant(
          fastify,
          input.projectId,
          targetTenantId
        );
      }
      const clientId = generateToken(16);
      const clientSecret = input.public ? null : generateToken(32);
      const secretHash = clientSecret ? await hashPassword(clientSecret) : null;
      const client = await fastify.db.client.create({
        data: {
          name: input.name,
          clientId,
          clientSecret: secretHash,
          grantTypes: input.grantTypes,
          scopes: input.scopes,
          public: input.public,
          requirePkce: input.requirePkce,
          tenantId: targetTenantId,
          projectId: input.projectId ?? null,
          logoUri: input.logoUri,
          tosUri: input.tosUri,
          policyUri: input.policyUri,
          redirectUris: { create: input.redirectUris.map((uri) => ({ uri })) }
        },
        include: { redirectUris: true }
      });
      await fastify.db.auditLog.create({
        data: {
          actionId: "OAUTH_CLIENT_CREATED",
          tenantId: targetTenantId,
          identityId: req.identity.id,
          ip: req.ip,
          metadata: {
            clientId,
            name: input.name,
            projectId: input.projectId ?? null
          }
        }
      });
      return reply.status(201).send({
        success: true,
        data: {
          clientId,
          clientSecret: clientSecret ?? null,
          name: client.name,
          projectId: client.projectId,
          grantTypes: client.grantTypes,
          scopes: client.scopes,
          redirectUris: client.redirectUris.map(
            (r) => r.uri
          ),
          public: client.public,
          requirePkce: client.requirePkce
        }
      });
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/clients",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth2 / OIDC Server"],
        summary: "List OAuth clients for your active tenant, optionally filtered by project (PRO)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        querystring: z34.object({
          tenantId: z34.string().cuid().optional(),
          projectId: z34.string().cuid().optional()
          // ← NEW
        }),
        response: {
          200: z34.object({ success: z34.boolean(), data: z34.array(z34.any()) })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { tenantId, projectId } = req.query;
      const targetTenantId = tenantId ?? req.identity.tenantId ?? "SYSTEM";
      if (!await hasPermission(
        fastify.db,
        req.identity.id,
        targetTenantId,
        "client:read"
      )) {
        throw ApiError.forbidden("Permission required: client:read");
      }
      const clients = await fastify.db.client.findMany({
        where: {
          tenantId: targetTenantId,
          ...projectId ? { projectId } : {}
        },
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          clientId: true,
          public: true,
          grantTypes: true,
          scopes: true,
          tenantId: true,
          projectId: true,
          createdAt: true,
          requirePkce: true,
          redirectUris: { select: { uri: true } }
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }
      });
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: clients });
    }
  );
  fastify.delete(
    "/clients/:clientId",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth2 / OIDC Server"],
        summary: "Delete an OAuth client (PRO)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: z34.object({ clientId: z34.string().min(1) }),
        response: { 200: z34.object({ success: z34.boolean() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { clientId } = req.params;
      const client = await fastify.db.client.findFirst({ where: { clientId } });
      if (!client) throw ApiError.notFound("Client not found");
      const clientTenantId = client.tenantId ?? "SYSTEM";
      if (!await hasPermission(
        fastify.db,
        req.identity.id,
        clientTenantId,
        "client:delete"
      )) {
        throw ApiError.forbidden("Permission required: client:delete");
      }
      await fastify.db.client.delete({ where: { id: client.id } });
      return reply.send({ success: true });
    }
  );
}

// src/modules/oauth/routes/consent.route.ts
import { z as z35 } from "zod";
async function consentRoute(fastify) {
  const db = fastify.db;
  fastify.post(
    "/consent",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Protocol"],
        summary: "Grant scopes for an OAuth client on behalf of the current user",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        body: z35.object({
          clientId: z35.string().min(1),
          scopes: z35.array(z35.string()).min(1)
        }),
        response: {
          200: z35.object({ success: z35.boolean() }),
          404: commonErrorSchema
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { clientId, scopes } = req.body;
      const client = await db.client.findFirst({
        where: { clientId },
        select: { id: true, scopes: true }
      });
      if (!client) {
        return reply.status(404).send({ success: false, error: "CLIENT_NOT_FOUND" });
      }
      const clientScopes = Array.isArray(client.scopes) ? client.scopes : [];
      const allowed = scopes.filter((s) => clientScopes.includes(s));
      await db.oAuthConsent.upsert({
        where: {
          identityId_clientId: {
            identityId: req.identity.id,
            clientId: client.id
          }
        },
        update: {
          scopes: allowed,
          updatedAt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date()
        },
        create: {
          identityId: req.identity.id,
          clientId: client.id,
          scopes: allowed
        }
      });
      await db.auditLog.create({
        data: {
          actionId: "OAUTH_CONSENT_GRANTED",
          identityId: req.identity.id,
          ip: req.ip,
          userAgent: req.headers["user-agent"],
          metadata: { clientId, scopes: allowed }
        }
      });
      return reply.send({ success: true });
    }
  );
  fastify.delete(
    "/consent/:clientId",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Protocol"],
        summary: "Revoke previously granted consent",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: z35.object({ clientId: z35.string().min(1) }),
        response: { 200: z35.object({ success: z35.boolean() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { clientId } = req.params;
      const client = await db.client.findFirst({
        where: { clientId },
        select: { id: true }
      });
      if (client) {
        await db.oAuthConsent.deleteMany({
          where: { identityId: req.identity.id, clientId: client.id }
        });
      }
      return reply.send({ success: true });
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/consents",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Protocol"],
        summary: "List all granted OAuth consents",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        response: {
          200: z35.object({ success: z35.boolean(), data: z35.array(z35.any()) })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const consents = await db.oAuthConsent.findMany({
        where: { identityId: req.identity.id },
        include: { client: { select: { clientId: true, name: true } } }
      });
      return reply.send({
        success: true,
        data: consents.map((c) => ({
          clientId: c.client.clientId,
          clientName: c.client.name,
          scopes: c.scopes,
          grantedAt: c.grantedAt
        }))
      });
    }
  );
}

  picture: z36.string().url().optional(),

// src/modules/identity/routes/profile.route.ts
async function profileRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.get(
    "/profile",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity & Profile"],
        summary: "Retrieve canonical identity profile with tenant memberships and roles",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        response: {
          200: z37.object({ success: z37.boolean(), data: z37.any() })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const identity = await fastify.db.identity.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: req.identity.id },
        include: {
          memberships: {
            where: { status: "ACTIVE" },
            include: { role: true }
          }
        }
      });
      return reply.send({
        success: true,
        data: {
          ...presentIdentity2(identity),
          plan: req.identity.plan,
          tenantId: req.identity.tenantId,
          memberships: identity.memberships.map((m) => ({
            tenantId: m.tenantId,
            role: m.role.name,
            status: m.status,
            joinedAt: m.createdAt
          }))
        }
      });
    }
  );
  fastify.patch(
    "/profile",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity & Profile"],
        summary: "Update display name and profile picture",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        body: UpdateProfileSchema,
        response: {
          200: z37.object({ success: z37.boolean(), data: z37.any() })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const body2 = req.body;
      const identity = await fastify.db.identity.update({
        where: { id: req.identity.id },
        data: {
          name: body2.name,
          picture: body2.picture,
          metadata: body2.metadata ? body2.metadata : void 0
        },
        include: {
          memberships: {
            where: { status: "ACTIVE" },
            include: { role: true }
          }
        }
      });
      void auditService.log({
        action: "PROFILE_UPDATED",
        identityId: req.identity.id,
        ip: req.ip,
        metadata: { fields: Object.keys(body2) }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: presentIdentity2(identity) });
    }
  );
  fastify.delete(
    "/profile",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireElevated,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity & Profile"],
        summary: "Permanently delete account (requires step-up re-authentication)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        response: {
          200: z37.object({ success: z37.boolean(), message: z37.string() })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const identityId = req.identity.id;
      const identity = await fastify.db.identity.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: identityId },
        select: { primaryEmail: true, name: true }
      });
      await fastify.db.$transaction([
        fastify.db.session.updateMany({
          where: { identityId, valid: true },
          data: { valid: false }
        }),
        fastify.db.accessToken.updateMany({
          where: { identityId, revoked: false },
          data: { revoked: true }
        }),
        fastify.db.refreshToken.updateMany({
          where: { identityId, revoked: false },
          data: { revoked: true }
        })
      ]);
      await fastify.db.identity.delete({ where: { id: identityId } });
      void auditService.log({
        action: "USER_DELETED",
        identityId,
        ip: req.ip,
        metadata: { email: identity.primaryEmail }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      return reply.send({
        success: true,
        message: "Account permanently deleted"
      });
    }
  );
}

// src/modules/identity/routes/delegation.route.ts
import { z as z40 } from "zod";
async function delegationRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.get(
    "/delegations",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity"],
        summary: "List delegations granted by this identity [not yet implemented]",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        response: {
          501: z40.object({ error: z40.string(), message: z40.string() })
        }
      }
    },
    async (_req, reply) => {
      return reply.status(501).send({
        error: "NOT_IMPLEMENTED",

// src/modules/identity/routes/admin.route.ts
import { z as z41 } from "zod";
async function revokeAllSessions(fastify, identityId) {
  await fastify.db.$transaction([
    fastify.db.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { identityId, revoked: false },
      data: { revoked: true, rotatedAt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() }
    }),
    fastify.db.session.updateMany({
      where: { identityId, valid: true },
      data: { valid: false }
    })
  ]);
}
function statusToAuditAction(status) {
  switch (status) {
    case "SUSPENDED":
      return "IDENTITY_SUSPENDED";
    case "BANNED":
      return "IDENTITY_BANNED";
    default:
      return null;
  }
}
async function adminRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.get(
    "/admin",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requireUser,
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("admin:system", "SYSTEM")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Vault"],
        summary: "Admin: list identities",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        querystring: z41.object({
          limit: z41.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(20),
          page: z41.coerce.number().int().min(1).default(1),
          status: z41.enum(["ACTIVE", "SUSPENDED", "BANNED", "PENDING", "DELETED"]).optional(),
          search: z41.string().optional()
        }),
        response: {
          200: z41.object({
            success: z41.boolean(),
            data: z41.array(z41.any()),
            meta: z41.object({
              total: z41.number(),
              page: z41.number(),
              limit: z41.number()
            })
          })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { limit, page, status, search } = req.query;
      const where = {};
      if (status) where.status = status;
      if (search)
        where.OR = [
          { primaryEmail: { contains: search, mode: "insensitive" } },
          { name: { contains: search, mode: "insensitive" } }
        ];
      const [identities, total] = await Promise.all([
        fastify.db.identity.findMany({
          where,
          skip: (page - 1) * limit,
          take: limit,
          orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
          select: {
            id: true,
            primaryEmail: true,
            name: true,
            status: true,
            emailVerified: true,
            createdAt: true
          }
        }),
        fastify.db.identity.count({ where })
      ]);
      return reply.send({
        success: true,
        data: identities,
        meta: { total, page, limit }
      });
    }
  );
  fastify.post(
    "/admin/:id/suspend",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requireUser,
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("admin:system", "SYSTEM")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Vault"],
        summary: "Admin: suspend identity",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: z41.object({ id: z41.string() }),
        body: z41.object({ reason: z41.string().optional() }),
        response: { 200: z41.object({ success: z41.boolean() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const { reason } = req.body;
      const identity = await fastify.db.identity.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { status: "SUSPENDED" },
        select: { primaryEmail: true, name: true }
      });
      await revokeAllSessions(fastify, id);
      if (identity.primaryEmail) {
        const { notificationService: notificationService2 } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => (init_notification_service(), notification_service_exports));
        void notificationService2.sendAccountSuspended(identity.primaryEmail, {
          name: identity.name ?? void 0,
          reason
        }).catch(() => {
        });
      }
      await auditService.log({
        action: "IDENTITY_SUSPENDED",
        identityId: id,
        ip: req.ip ?? "0.0.0.0",
        metadata: { reason }
      });
      return reply.send({ success: true });
    }
  );
  fastify.patch(
    "/:id/status",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requireUser,
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("admin:system", "SYSTEM")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Vault"],
        summary: "Admin: update identity status",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: z41.object({ id: z41.string() }),
        body: z41.object({
          status: z41.enum(["ACTIVE", "SUSPENDED", "BANNED"]),
          reason: z41.string().optional()
        }),
        response: { 200: z41.object({ success: z41.boolean() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const { status, reason } = req.body;
      const identity = await fastify.db.identity.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { status },
        select: { primaryEmail: true, name: true }
      });
      if (status === "SUSPENDED" || status === "BANNED") {
        await revokeAllSessions(fastify, id);
      }
      if (status === "SUSPENDED" && identity.primaryEmail) {
        const { notificationService: notificationService2 } = await Promise.resolve().then(() => (init_notification_service(), notification_service_exports));
        void notificationService2.sendAccountSuspended(identity.primaryEmail, {
          name: identity.name ?? void 0,
          reason
        }).catch(() => {
        });
      }
      const auditAction = statusToAuditAction(status);
      if (auditAction) {
        await auditService.log({
          action: auditAction,
          identityId: id,
          ip: req.ip ?? "0.0.0.0",
          metadata: { status, reason }
        });
      }
      return reply.send({ success: true });
    }
  );
}

// src/modules/tenant/services/project.service.ts
var ProjectService = class {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
  }
  /** Re-uses the same membership check pattern as TenantService.assertMembership. */
  async assertMembership(tenantId, identityId) {
    const membership = await this.db.tenantMembership.findFirst({
      where: { identityId, tenantId, status: "ACTIVE" },
      select: { id: true }
    });
    if (!membership) {
      throw ApiError.forbidden("You are not a member of this tenant");
    }
  }
  async create(tenantId, input) {
    const existing = await this.db.project.findUnique({
      where: { slug: input.slug },
      select: { id: true }
    });
    if (existing) {
      throw ApiError.badRequest(
        `Project slug '${input.slug}' is already in use`
      );
    }
    return this.db.project.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        name: input.name,
        slug: input.slug,
        category: input.category ?? null
      }
    });
  }
  async list(tenantId, category) {
    return this.db.project.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        ...category ? { category } : {}
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      include: {
        _count: { select: { clients: true, onboardingFlows: true } }
      }
    });
  }
  async getById(tenantId, projectId) {
    const project = await this.db.project.findFirst({
      where: { id: projectId, tenantId },
      include: {
        clients: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            clientId: true,
            name: true,
            public: true,
            createdAt: true
          }
        },
        onboardingFlows: {
          select: { id: true, name: true, isActive: true, createdAt: true }
        }
      }
    });
    if (!project) throw ApiError.notFound("Project not found");
    return project;
  }
  async update(tenantId, projectId, input) {
    const existing = await this.db.project.findFirst({
      where: { id: projectId, tenantId },
      select: { id: true }
    });
    if (!existing) throw ApiError.notFound("Project not found");
    return this.db.project.update({
      where: { id: projectId },
      data: {
        ...input.name !== void 0 ? { name: input.name } : {},
        ...input.category !== void 0 ? { category: input.category } : {}
      }
    });
  }
  /**
   * Deleting a Project cascades to OnboardingFlow/OnboardingProgress
   * (Prisma onDelete: Cascade on that relation) but NOT to Client —
   * Client.projectId uses onDelete: SetNull, so OAuth clients survive
   * and fall back to tenant-level, since live tokens may depend on them.
   */
  async delete(tenantId, projectId) {
    const existing = await this.db.project.findFirst({
      where: { id: projectId, tenantId },
      select: { id: true }
    });
    if (!existing) throw ApiError.notFound("Project not found");
    await this.db.project.delete({ where: { id: projectId } });
  }
};

// src/modules/tenant/services/onboarding.service.ts
var OnboardingService = class {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
  }
  // ── Flow management (admin-facing) ─────────────────────────────────────
  async createFlow(projectId, input) {
    return this.db.onboardingFlow.create({
      data: {
        projectId,
        name: input.name,
        steps: input.steps,
        isActive: input.isActive
      }
    });
  }
  async listFlows(projectId) {
    return this.db.onboardingFlow.findMany({
      where: { projectId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      include: { _count: { select: { progresses: true } } }
    });
  }
  async getFlow(projectId, flowId) {
    const flow = await this.db.onboardingFlow.findFirst({
      where: { id: flowId, projectId }
    });
    if (!flow) throw ApiError.notFound("Onboarding flow not found");
    return flow;
  }
  async updateFlow(projectId, flowId, input) {
    const existing = await this.db.onboardingFlow.findFirst({
      where: { id: flowId, projectId },
      select: { id: true }
    });
    if (!existing) throw ApiError.notFound("Onboarding flow not found");
    return this.db.onboardingFlow.update({
      where: { id: flowId },
      data: {
        ...input.name !== void 0 ? { name: input.name } : {},
        ...input.steps !== void 0 ? { steps: input.steps } : {},
        ...input.isActive !== void 0 ? { isActive: input.isActive } : {}
      }
    });
  }
  async deleteFlow(projectId, flowId) {
    const existing = await this.db.onboardingFlow.findFirst({
      where: { id: flowId, projectId },
      select: { id: true }
    });
    if (!existing) throw ApiError.notFound("Onboarding flow not found");
    await this.db.onboardingFlow.delete({ where: { id: flowId } });
  }
  // ── Progress tracking (end-user facing) ─────────────────────────────────
  /**
   * Starts (or returns existing) progress for an identity on a flow.
   * Idempotent — calling this twice for the same identity+flow returns the
   * same row rather than erroring, since "start onboarding" is a natural
   * thing for a frontend to call on every visit to the onboarding screen.
   */
  async startProgress(identityId, flowId) {
    const flow = await this.db.onboardingFlow.findUnique({
      where: { id: flowId },
      select: { id: true, isActive: true }
    });
    if (!flow) throw ApiError.notFound("Onboarding flow not found");
    if (!flow.isActive) {
      throw ApiError.badRequest("This onboarding flow is no longer active");
    }
    return this.db.onboardingProgress.upsert({
      where: { identityId_flowId: { identityId, flowId } },
      update: {},
      // no-op if it already exists — just return current state
      create: {
        identityId,
        flowId,
        currentStep: 0,
        completedSteps: [],
        data: {}
      }
    });
  }
  async getProgress(identityId, progressId) {
    const progress = await this.db.onboardingProgress.findFirst({
      where: { id: progressId, identityId },
      include: {
        flow: { select: { name: true, steps: true, isActive: true } }
      }
    });
    if (!progress) throw ApiError.notFound("Onboarding progress not found");
    return progress;
  }
  /**
   * Marks a step complete, advances currentStep, and merges any collected
   * `data`. Setting completedAt happens when every step in flow.steps has
   * a matching id in completedSteps after this update.
   */
  async advanceProgress(identityId, progressId, input) {
    const progress = await this.db.onboardingProgress.findFirst({
      where: { id: progressId, identityId },
      include: { flow: { select: { steps: true } } }
    });
    if (!progress) throw ApiError.notFound("Onboarding progress not found");
    const completedSteps = Array.isArray(progress.completedSteps) ? progress.completedSteps : [];
    const updatedCompleted = completedSteps.includes(input.stepId) ? completedSteps : [...completedSteps, input.stepId];
    const mergedData = {
      ...progress.data,
      ...input.data ?? {}
    };
    const flowSteps = progress.flow.steps ?? [];
    const allStepIds = flowSteps.map((s) => s.id);
    const isComplete = allStepIds.length > 0 && allStepIds.every((id) => updatedCompleted.includes(id));
    return this.db.onboardingProgress.update({
      where: { id: progressId },
      data: {
        completedSteps: updatedCompleted,
        currentStep: updatedCompleted.length,
        data: mergedData,
        ...isComplete ? { completedAt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() } : {}
      }
    });
  }
};

  name: z42.string().min(1).max(100).optional(),
  steps: z42.array(OnboardingStepSchema).min(1).optional(),
  isActive: z42.boolean().optional()
});

  flowId: z42.string().cuid()

});

});

});

});

async function onboardingFlowRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.post(
    "/:tenantId/projects/:projectId/onboarding-flows",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requireUser,
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("onboarding:manage")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Onboarding Flows"],
        summary: "Create an onboarding flow for a project",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: ProjectFlowsParamsSchema,
        body: CreateOnboardingFlowSchema,
        response: { 201: z43.object({ success: z43.boolean(), data: z43.any() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { tenantId, projectId } = req.params;
      const body2 = req.body;
      const projectService = new ProjectService(fastify.db);
      await projectService.getById(tenantId, projectId);
      const onboardingService = new OnboardingService(fastify.db);
      const flow = await onboardingService.createFlow(projectId, body2);
      void auditService.log({
        action: "TENANT_UPDATED",
        identityId: req.identity.id,
        tenantId,
        ip: req.ip,
        metadata: {
          event: "onboarding_flow_created",
          projectId,
          flowId: flow.id
        }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      return reply.status(201).send({ success: true, data: flow });
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/:tenantId/projects/:projectId/onboarding-flows",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Onboarding Flows"],
        summary: "List onboarding flows for a project",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: ProjectFlowsParamsSchema,
        response: {
          200: z43.object({ success: z43.boolean(), data: z43.array(z43.any()) })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { tenantId, projectId } = req.params;
      const projectService = new ProjectService(fastify.db);
      await projectService.assertMembership(tenantId, req.identity.id);
      await projectService.getById(tenantId, projectId);
      const onboardingService = new OnboardingService(fastify.db);
      const flows = await onboardingService.listFlows(projectId);
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: flows });
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/:tenantId/projects/:projectId/onboarding-flows/:flowId",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Onboarding Flows"],
        summary: "Get a single onboarding flow",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: OnboardingFlowParamsSchema,
        response: { 200: z43.object({ success: z43.boolean(), data: z43.any() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { tenantId, projectId, flowId } = req.params;
      const projectService = new ProjectService(fastify.db);
      await projectService.assertMembership(tenantId, req.identity.id);
      await projectService.getById(tenantId, projectId);
      const onboardingService = new OnboardingService(fastify.db);
      const flow = await onboardingService.getFlow(projectId, flowId);
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: flow });
    }
  );
  fastify.patch(
    "/:tenantId/projects/:projectId/onboarding-flows/:flowId",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requireUser,
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("onboarding:manage")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Onboarding Flows"],
        summary: "Update an onboarding flow",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: OnboardingFlowParamsSchema,
        body: UpdateOnboardingFlowSchema,
        response: { 200: z43.object({ success: z43.boolean(), data: z43.any() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { tenantId, projectId, flowId } = req.params;
      const body2 = req.body;
      const projectService = new ProjectService(fastify.db);
      await projectService.getById(tenantId, projectId);
      const onboardingService = new OnboardingService(fastify.db);
      const flow = await onboardingService.updateFlow(projectId, flowId, body2);
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: flow });
    }
  );
  fastify.delete(
    "/:tenantId/projects/:projectId/onboarding-flows/:flowId",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requireUser,
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("onboarding:manage")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Onboarding Flows"],
        summary: "Delete an onboarding flow (also deletes all progress records on it)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: OnboardingFlowParamsSchema,
        response: { 200: z43.object({ success: z43.boolean() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { tenantId, projectId, flowId } = req.params;
      const projectService = new ProjectService(fastify.db);
      await projectService.getById(tenantId, projectId);
      const onboardingService = new OnboardingService(fastify.db);
      await onboardingService.deleteFlow(projectId, flowId);
      return reply.send({ success: true });
    }
  );
}
async function onboardingProgressRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.post(
    "/onboarding/start",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Onboarding Progress"],
        summary: "Start (or resume) onboarding progress for the current identity",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        body: StartProgressSchema,
        response: { 200: z43.object({ success: z43.boolean(), data: z43.any() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { flowId } = req.body;
      const onboardingService = new OnboardingService(fastify.db);
      const progress = await onboardingService.startProgress(
        req.identity.id,
        flowId
      );
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: progress });
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/onboarding/:progressId",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Onboarding Progress"],
        summary: "Get the current identity's progress on a flow",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: ProgressParamsSchema,
        response: { 200: z43.object({ success: z43.boolean(), data: z43.any() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { progressId } = req.params;
      const onboardingService = new OnboardingService(fastify.db);
      const progress = await onboardingService.getProgress(
        req.identity.id,
        progressId
      );
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: progress });
    }
  );
  fastify.post(
    "/onboarding/:progressId/advance",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Onboarding Progress"],
        summary: "Mark a step complete and advance the current identity's progress",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: ProgressParamsSchema,
        body: AdvanceProgressSchema,
        response: { 200: z43.object({ success: z43.boolean(), data: z43.any() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { progressId } = req.params;
      const body2 = req.body;
      const onboardingService = new OnboardingService(fastify.db);
      const progress = await onboardingService.advanceProgress(
        req.identity.id,
        progressId,
        body2
      );
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: progress });
    }
  );
}
