    {
      config: { rateLimit: { max: 30, timeWindow: "1 minute" } },
      schema: {
        tags: ["Verifiable Credentials Engine"],
        summary: "Present a credential for verification",
        description: "Accepts a credential proof bound to a verification session challenge. Verifies the detached JWS proof, checks credential validity (signature, expiry, revocation), and marks the session as consumed on success. No authentication required.",
        body: PresentBodySchema,
        response: {
          200: z70.union([PresentValidResponse, PresentInvalidResponse])
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { sessionId, credential, proof } = req.body;
      const session = await fastify.db.verifySession.findUnique({
        where: { id: sessionId },
        select: {
          id: true,
          challenge: true,
          status: true,
          expiresAt: true
        }
      });
      if (!session) {
        throw ApiError.notFound("Verification session not found");
      }
      const status = session.status;
      if (status === "CONSUMED" || status === "EXPIRED" || session.expiresAt < /* @__PURE__ */ new Date()) {
        throw new ApiError(
          "Verification session has expired or been consumed",
          410,
          "GONE"
        );
      }
      let kid;
      try {
        const header2 = decodeProtectedHeader2(proof);
        kid = header2.kid ?? "";
      } catch {
        return reply.send({ valid: false, reason: "invalid_proof" });
      }
      const didKey = kid.split("#")[0];
      if (!didKey) {
        return reply.send({ valid: false, reason: "invalid_proof" });
      }
      const credentialHash = crypto3.createHash("sha256").update(credential).digest("base64url");
      const proofValid = await verifyDetachedJws(
        proof,
        session.challenge,
        credentialHash,
        didKey,
        fastify.db
      );
      if (!proofValid) {
        return reply.send({ valid: false, reason: "invalid_proof" });
      }
      const verifyResult = await flowExecutor.run(
        verifyCredentialFlow,
        { credential },
        { tenantId: null },
        { transaction: false }
      );
      if (!verifyResult.valid) {
        return reply.send({
          valid: false,
          reason: verifyResult.reason ?? "verification_failed"
        });
      }
      await fastify.db.verifySession.update({
        where: { id: sessionId },
        data: { status: "CONSUMED" }
      });
      return reply.send({
        valid: true,
        claims: verifyResult.claims ?? {},
        sessionId: session.id
      });
    }
  );
}

// src/modules/billing/services/subscription.service.ts
var SubscriptionService = class {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
  }
  async getForTenant(tenantId) {
    return this.db.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: { billingIntegrations: true }
    });
  }
  async activateFromProvider(tenantId, plan, provider, externalCustomerId, externalSubId) {
    return this.db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const subscription = await tx.subscription.upsert({
        where: { tenantId },
        update: { plan, status: "ACTIVE" },
        create: { tenantId, plan, status: "ACTIVE" }
      });
      if (provider && externalSubId) {
        await tx.externalBillingIntegration.upsert({
          where: {
            providerName_externalSubId: {
              providerName: provider,
              externalSubId
            }
          },
          update: { externalCustomerId, metadata: { plan } },
          create: {
            subscriptionId: subscription.id,
            providerName: provider,
            externalCustomerId,
            externalSubId,
            metadata: { plan }
          }
        });
      }
      return subscription;
    });
  }
  async cancelFromProvider(tenantId) {
    return this.db.subscription.update({
      where: { tenantId },
      data: { plan: "FREE", status: "ACTIVE", endsAt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() }
    });
  }
};

// src/modules/billing/routes/subscription.route.ts
init_config2();
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from "crypto";
import { z as z71 } from "zod";
var PAYSTACK_PLAN_MAP = {
  PLN_arcid_pro: "PRO",
  PLN_arcid_enterprise: "ENTERPRISE"
};
var STRIPE_PLAN_MAP = {
  price_arcid_pro: "PRO",
  price_arcid_enterprise: "ENTERPRISE"
};
function verifyPaystackWebhook(payload, signature) {
  if (!config.billing.paystack.webhookSecret) return false;
  const expected = createHmac("sha512", config.billing.paystack.webhookSecret).update(payload).digest("hex");
  try {
    return timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(expected), Buffer.from(signature));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
function verifyStripeWebhook(payload, signature) {
  if (!config.billing.stripe.webhookSecret) return false;
  const expected = createHmac("sha256", config.billing.stripe.webhookSecret).update(payload).digest("hex");
  try {
    return timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(expected), Buffer.from(signature));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
async function subscriptionRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.get(
    "/subscription",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Billing & Subscriptions"],
        summary: "Get the current subscription plan for the authenticated user's tenant",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        response: {
          200: z71.object({ success: z71.boolean(), data: z71.any().nullable() })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const tenantId = req.identity.tenantId ?? "SYSTEM";
      const subService = new SubscriptionService(fastify.db);
      const sub = await subService.getForTenant(tenantId);
      return reply.send({
        success: true,
        data: sub ?? { tenantId, plan: "FREE", status: "ACTIVE" }
      });
    }
  );
  fastify.post(
    "/subscription/upgrade",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requireUser,
      schema: {
        tags: ["Billing & Subscriptions"],
        summary: "Upgrade the tenant subscription plan (removed \u2014 use payment provider)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        response: { 410: z71.object({ error: z71.string(), code: z71.string() }) }
      }
    },
    async (_req, reply) => {
      return reply.status(410).send({
        error: "Self-service upgrades are removed. Use your payment provider portal to change plans.",
        code: "UPGRADE_ENDPOINT_REMOVED"
      });
    }
  );
  fastify.post(
    "/webhooks/billing/paystack",
    { config: { rawBody: true } },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const rawBody = req.rawBody;
      const sig = req.headers["x-paystack-signature"];
      if (!verifyPaystackWebhook(rawBody, sig)) {
        return reply.status(401).send({ error: "Invalid signature" });
      }
      const event = JSON.parse(rawBody);
      fastify.log.info({ event: event.event }, "[BILLING][PAYSTACK]");
      const { event: eventName, data } = event;
      const tenantId = data?.metadata?.tenantId ?? data?.customer?.metadata?.tenantId;
      if (!tenantId) {
        fastify.log.warn(
          "[BILLING][PAYSTACK] No tenantId in metadata \u2014 ignoring event"
        );
        return reply.status(200).send({ received: true });
      }
      const subService = new SubscriptionService(fastify.db);
      if (eventName === "subscription.create" || eventName === "charge.success") {
        const planCode = data?.plan?.plan_code ?? data?.plan_code;
        const plan = PAYSTACK_PLAN_MAP[planCode];
        if (plan) {
          await subService.activateFromProvider(
            tenantId,
            plan,
            "PAYSTACK",
            data?.customer?.customer_code,
            data?.subscription_code ?? data?.reference
          );
          await auditService.log({
            action: "SUBSCRIPTION_UPGRADED",
            tenantId,
            metadata: { plan, provider: "PAYSTACK" }
          });
          fastify.log.info(
            { tenantId, plan },
            "[BILLING][PAYSTACK] Plan activated"
          );
        }
      }
      if (eventName === "subscription.not_renew" || eventName === "subscription.disable") {
        await subService.cancelFromProvider(tenantId);
        await auditService.log({
          action: "SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELLED",
          tenantId,
          metadata: { provider: "PAYSTACK" }
        });
        fastify.log.info(
          { tenantId },
          "[BILLING][PAYSTACK] Subscription cancelled \u2192 FREE"
        );
      }
      return reply.status(200).send({ received: true });
    }
  );
  fastify.post(
    "/webhooks/billing/stripe",
    { config: { rawBody: true } },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const rawBody = req.rawBody;
      const sig = req.headers["stripe-signature"];
      if (!verifyStripeWebhook(rawBody, sig)) {
        return reply.status(401).send({ error: "Invalid signature" });
      }
      const event = JSON.parse(rawBody);
      fastify.log.info({ type: event.type }, "[BILLING][STRIPE]");
      const subService = new SubscriptionService(fastify.db);
      const obj = event.data?.object;
      const tenantId = obj?.metadata?.tenantId;
      if (!tenantId) {
        fastify.log.warn(
          "[BILLING][STRIPE] No tenantId in metadata \u2014 ignoring event"
        );
        return reply.status(200).send({ received: true });
      }
      if (event.type === "customer.subscription.created" || event.type === "invoice.payment_succeeded") {
        const priceId = obj?.items?.data?.[0]?.price?.id ?? obj?.lines?.data?.[0]?.price?.id;
        const plan = STRIPE_PLAN_MAP[priceId];
        if (plan) {
          await subService.activateFromProvider(
            tenantId,
            plan,
            "STRIPE",
            obj?.customer,
            obj?.subscription ?? obj?.id
          );
          await auditService.log({
            action: "SUBSCRIPTION_UPGRADED",
            tenantId,
            metadata: { plan, provider: "STRIPE" }
          });
          fastify.log.info(
            { tenantId, plan },
            "[BILLING][STRIPE] Plan activated"
          );
        }
      }
      if (event.type === "customer.subscription.deleted") {
        await subService.cancelFromProvider(tenantId);
        await auditService.log({
          action: "SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELLED",
          tenantId,
          metadata: { provider: "STRIPE" }
        });
        fastify.log.info(
          { tenantId },
          "[BILLING][STRIPE] Subscription cancelled \u2192 FREE"
        );
      }
      return reply.status(200).send({ received: true });
    }
  );
}

// src/modules/audit/flows/query-audit-logs.flow.ts
import { z as z73 } from "zod";

// src/modules/audit/repositories/audit.repository.ts
var AuditRepository = class {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
  }
  async query(params) {
    const where = {};
    if (params.identityId) where.identityId = params.identityId;
    if (params.tenantId) where.tenantId = params.tenantId;
    if (params.from || params.to) {
      where.createdAt = {};
      if (params.from) where.createdAt.gte = params.from;
      if (params.to) where.createdAt.lte = params.to;
    }
    const [logs, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.db.auditLog.findMany({
        where,
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        skip: (params.page - 1) * params.limit,
        take: params.limit
      }),
      this.db.auditLog.count({ where })
    ]);
    return { logs, total, page: params.page, limit: params.limit };
  }
};

// src/modules/audit/flows/query-audit-logs.flow.ts
var QueryAuditLogsInputSchema = z73.object({
  query: AuditQuerySchema,
  requesterIdentityId: z73.string(),
  requesterTenantId: z73.string().nullable().optional()
});
var queryAuditLogsFlow = {
  name: "audit:query-logs",
  inputSchema: QueryAuditLogsInputSchema,
  async execute(input, ctx) {
    const { query, requesterIdentityId, requesterTenantId } = input;
    const isSystemAdmin = await hasPermission(
      ctx.db,
      requesterIdentityId,
      "SYSTEM",
      "audit:read:any"
    );
    const auditRepo = new AuditRepository(ctx.db);
    return auditRepo.query({
      identityId: isSystemAdmin ? query.identityId : requesterIdentityId,
      tenantId: isSystemAdmin ? query.tenantId : requesterTenantId ?? void 0,
      from: query.from ? new Date(query.from) : void 0,
      to: query.to ? new Date(query.to) : void 0,
      page: query.page,
      limit: query.limit
    });
  }
};

// src/modules/audit/routes/audit.route.ts
async function auditRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.get(
    "/logs",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["Ecosystem Audit Guard"],
        summary: "Query audit logs \u2014 own logs for PRO+; all logs for SYSTEM ADMINs (PRO)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        querystring: AuditQuerySchema,
        response: {
          200: z74.object({
            success: z74.boolean(),
            data: z74.array(z74.any()),
            meta: z74.object({
              total: z74.number(),
              page: z74.number(),
              limit: z74.number()
            })
          })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const query = AuditQuerySchema.parse(req.query);
      const result = await flowExecutor.run(
        queryAuditLogsFlow,
        {
          query,
          requesterIdentityId: req.identity.id,
          requesterTenantId: req.identity.tenantId ?? null
        },
        {
          tenantId: req.identity.tenantId ?? null,
          identityId: req.identity.id
        }
      );
      return reply.send({
        success: true,
        data: result.logs.map(presentAuditLog),
        meta: { total: result.total, page: result.page, limit: result.limit }
      });
    }
  );
}

  secret: z76.string().min(16).max(256).optional(),

// src/modules/webhooks/routes/webhook-config.route.ts
async function webhookConfigRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.post(
    "/endpoints",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("webhook:manage")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Webhook Delivery Engine"],
        summary: "Register a new outbound webhook endpoint for your tenant (PRO)",
        description: "Registers a URL to receive webhook events. A signing secret is returned, store it securely and use it to verify the X-ArcID-Signature header on incoming requests.",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        body: EndpointBodySchema,
        response: {
          201: z77.object({
            success: z77.boolean(),
            data: z77.object({
              id: z77.string(),
              url: z77.string(),
              secret: z77.string().describe(
                "HMAC signing secret \u2014 only returned at creation. Store it securely."
              ),
              eventTypes: z77.array(z77.string()),
              enabled: z77.boolean(),
              createdAt: z77.string()
            })
          })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const body2 = req.body;
      const tenantId = req.identity.tenantId;
      if (!tenantId) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "Webhook endpoints must be scoped to a tenant. Switch to a tenant context first via POST /auth/context/switch."
        );
      }
      assertSafeUrl(body2.url);
      const count = await fastify.db.webhookEndpoint.count({
        where: { tenantId, enabled: true }
      });
      if (count >= 10) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "Maximum of 10 active webhook endpoints per tenant. Disable or delete an existing endpoint before adding a new one."
        );
      }
      const secret = body2.secret ?? randomBytes4(32).toString("hex");
      const endpoint = await fastify.db.webhookEndpoint.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          url: body2.url,
          secret,
          eventTypes: body2.eventTypes,
          enabled: body2.enabled,
          createdBy: req.identity.id
        }
      });
      void auditService.log({
        action: "WEBHOOK_DELIVERED",
        identityId: req.identity.id,
        tenantId,
        ip: req.ip,
        metadata: {
          endpointId: endpoint.id,
          url: body2.url,
          action: "CREATED"
        }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      return reply.status(201).send({
        success: true,
        data: {
          id: endpoint.id,
          url: endpoint.url,
          secret,
          eventTypes: endpoint.eventTypes,
          enabled: endpoint.enabled,
          createdAt: endpoint.createdAt.toISOString()
        }
      });
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/endpoints",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["Webhook Delivery Engine"],
        summary: "List all webhook endpoints registered for your tenant (PRO)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        response: {
          200: z77.object({ success: z77.boolean(), data: z77.array(z77.any()) })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const tenantId = req.identity.tenantId;
      if (!tenantId) throw ApiError.badRequest("No active tenant context");
      const endpoints = await fastify.db.webhookEndpoint.findMany({
        where: { tenantId },
        select: {
          id: true,
          url: true,
          eventTypes: true,
          enabled: true,
          createdAt: true,
          updatedAt: true
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }
      });
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: endpoints });
    }
  );
  fastify.patch(
    "/endpoints/:id",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("webhook:manage")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Webhook Delivery Engine"],
        summary: "Update a webhook endpoint \u2014 enable/disable, change URL or event filter (PRO)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: EndpointParamsSchema,
        body: EndpointPatchSchema,
        response: {
          200: z77.object({ success: z77.boolean(), data: z77.any() })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const body2 = req.body;
      const tenantId = req.identity.tenantId;
      if (!tenantId) throw ApiError.badRequest("No active tenant context");
      const endpoint = await fastify.db.webhookEndpoint.findFirst({
        where: { id, tenantId }
      });
      if (!endpoint) throw ApiError.notFound("Webhook endpoint not found");
      if (body2.url) assertSafeUrl(body2.url);
      const updated = await fastify.db.webhookEndpoint.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          url: body2.url,
          eventTypes: body2.eventTypes,
          enabled: body2.enabled
        },
        select: {
          id: true,
          url: true,
          eventTypes: true,
          enabled: true,
          createdAt: true,
          updatedAt: true
        }
      });
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: updated });
    }
  );
  fastify.delete(
    "/endpoints/:id",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("webhook:manage")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Webhook Delivery Engine"],
        summary: "Remove a webhook endpoint (PRO)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: EndpointParamsSchema,
        response: {
          200: z77.object({ success: z77.boolean() })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const tenantId = req.identity.tenantId;
      if (!tenantId) throw ApiError.badRequest("No active tenant context");
      const endpoint = await fastify.db.webhookEndpoint.findFirst({
        where: { id, tenantId }
      });
      if (!endpoint) throw ApiError.notFound("Webhook endpoint not found");
      await fastify.db.webhookEndpoint.delete({ where: { id } });
      return reply.send({ success: true });
    }
  );
  fastify.post(
    "/endpoints/:id/test",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["Webhook Delivery Engine"],
        summary: "Send a test ping to a webhook endpoint (PRO)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: EndpointParamsSchema,
        response: {
          200: z77.object({
            success: z77.boolean(),
            delivered: z77.boolean(),
            statusCode: z77.number().optional(),
            error: z77.string().optional()
          })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const tenantId = req.identity.tenantId;
      if (!tenantId) throw ApiError.badRequest("No active tenant context");
      const endpoint = await fastify.db.webhookEndpoint.findFirst({
        where: { id, tenantId }
      });
      if (!endpoint) throw ApiError.notFound("Webhook endpoint not found");
      if (!endpoint.enabled) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "Endpoint is disabled. Enable it before sending a test ping."
        );
      }
      const timestamp = Date.now();
      const body2 = JSON.stringify({
        eventType: "WEBHOOK_TEST",
        tenantId,
        payload: { message: "ArcID webhook test ping", timestamp },
        createdAt: (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString()
      });
      const signature = createHmac2("sha256", endpoint.secret).update(`${timestamp}.${body2}`).digest("hex");
      try {
        const res = await fetchWithSsrfGuard(endpoint.url, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "X-ArcID-Signature": `sha256=${signature}`,
            "X-ArcID-Timestamp": String(timestamp),
            "X-ArcID-Event-Type": "WEBHOOK_TEST"
          },
          body: body2,
          signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1e4)
        });
        return reply.send({
          success: true,
          delivered: res.ok,
          statusCode: res.status
        });
      } catch (err) {
        return reply.send({
          success: true,
          delivered: false,
          error: err?.message ?? "Delivery failed"
        });
      }
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/events",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("webhook:read:events")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Webhook Delivery Engine"],
        summary: "List webhook delivery events for your tenant, optionally filtered by status (PRO)",
        description: "status=failed returns events that exhausted all retry attempts (deliveredAt is null and nextRetryAt is null). status=pending returns events still awaiting delivery or retry. Omit status for all.",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        querystring: EventListQuerySchema,
        response: {
          200: z77.object({
            success: z77.boolean(),
            data: z77.array(z77.any()),
            nextCursor: z77.string().nullable()
          })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { status, limit, cursor } = req.query;
      const tenantId = req.identity.tenantId;
      if (!tenantId) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "Webhook events must be scoped to a tenant. Switch to a tenant context first via POST /auth/context/switch."
        );
      }
      const statusFilter = status === "failed" ? { deliveredAt: null, nextRetryAt: null } : status === "pending" ? { deliveredAt: null, nextRetryAt: { not: null } } : status === "delivered" ? { deliveredAt: { not: null } } : {};
      const events = await fastify.db.webhookEvent.findMany({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          ...statusFilter,
          ...cursor ? { id: { lt: cursor } } : {}
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: limit,
        select: {
          id: true,
          eventType: true,
          targetUrl: true,
          attempts: true,
          maxAttempts: true,
          deliveredAt: true,
          lastError: true,
          createdAt: true,
          nextRetryAt: true
        }
      });
      return reply.send({
        success: true,
        data: events,
        nextCursor: events.length === limit ? events[events.length - 1].id : null
      });
    }
  );
  fastify.post(
    "/events/:id/retry",
    {
      preHandler: [
        fastify.auth.requirePlan("PRO"),
        fastify.auth.requirePermission("webhook:events:retry")
      ],
      schema: {
        tags: ["Webhook Delivery Engine"],
        summary: "Manually re-queue a failed webhook event for delivery (PRO)",
        description: "Resets attempts to 0 and nextRetryAt to now, so the worker picks it up on its next poll. Only valid for events that have exhausted retries (deliveredAt and nextRetryAt both null) \u2014 an event still actively retrying, or already delivered, can't be manually retried.",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: EventParamsSchema,
        response: {
          200: z77.object({ success: z77.boolean(), data: z77.any() })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const tenantId = req.identity.tenantId;
      if (!tenantId) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "Webhook events must be scoped to a tenant. Switch to a tenant context first via POST /auth/context/switch."
        );
      }
      const event = await fastify.db.webhookEvent.findFirst({
        where: { id, tenantId }
      });
      if (!event) {
        throw ApiError.notFound("Webhook event not found");
      }
      if (event.deliveredAt !== null) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "This event was already delivered \u2014 nothing to retry"
        );
      }
      if (event.nextRetryAt !== null) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "This event is still actively retrying \u2014 manual retry is only for events that have exhausted all attempts"
        );
      }
      const updated = await fastify.db.webhookEvent.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          attempts: 0,
          nextRetryAt: /* @__PURE__ */ new Date(),
          lastError: null
        }
      });
      void auditService.log({
        action: "WEBHOOK_DELIVERED",
        identityId: req.identity.id,
        tenantId,
        ip: req.ip,
        metadata: {
          eventId: id,
          action: "MANUAL_RETRY_QUEUED"
        }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: updated });
    }
  );
}

var CreateConnectionSchema = z78.object({
  tenantId: z78.string().cuid("Invalid tenant ID"),
  type: z78.enum(["SAML2", "OIDC", "OAUTH2"]),
  name: z78.string().min(1).max(100),
  domain: z78.string().optional(),
  entryPoint: z78.string().url().optional(),
  issuer: z78.string().optional(),
  // FIX: field is 'cert' in our DB/schema but the SAML library uses 'publicCert'
  // We accept 'cert' as the API surface and map to 'publicCert' inside buildSamlInstance.
  cert: z78.string().optional(),
  metadataUrl: z78.string().url().optional(),
  clientId: z78.string().optional(),
  clientSecret: z78.string().optional(),
  discoveryUrl: z78.string().url().optional()
});

  tenantId: true,
  type: true
}).partial();

  id: z78.string().cuid("Invalid connection ID")
});

  tenantSlug: z78.string().min(1).max(100)
});

});

// src/modules/idp/services/idp.service.ts
import { SAML } from "@node-saml/node-saml";
init_config2();
init_crypto2();
function buildSamlInstance(connection, tenantSlug) {
  if (!connection.entryPoint) {
    throw ApiError.badRequest("IdP entryPoint (SSO URL) is not configured");
  }
  if (!connection.cert) {
    throw ApiError.badRequest("IdP certificate is not configured");
  }
  const callbackUrl = `${config.base.apiUrl}/api/v1/idp/saml/${tenantSlug}/callback`;
  const entityId = `${config.base.apiUrl}/api/v1/idp/saml/${tenantSlug}/metadata`;
  assertSafeUrl(connection.entryPoint);
  return new SAML({
    entryPoint: connection.entryPoint,
    issuer: connection.issuer ?? entityId,
    publicCert: connection.cert,
    idpCert: connection.cert,
    // Resolves structural requirement error TS2345
    callbackUrl,
    wantAssertionsSigned: true,
    acceptedClockSkewMs: 3e5
  });
}
function generateSamlMetadata(connection, tenantSlug) {
  const saml = buildSamlInstance(connection, tenantSlug);
  return saml.generateServiceProviderMetadata(null, null);
}
function generateMinimalSamlMetadata(tenantSlug) {
  const acsUrl = `${config.base.apiUrl}/api/v1/idp/saml/${tenantSlug}/callback`;
  const entityId = `${config.base.apiUrl}/api/v1/idp/saml/${tenantSlug}/metadata`;
  return `<?xml version="1.0"?>
<EntityDescriptor xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:metadata" entityID="${entityId}">
  <SPSSODescriptor
    AuthnRequestsSigned="false"
    WantAssertionsSigned="true"
    protocolSupportEnumeration="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol">
    <AssertionConsumerService
      Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST"
      Location="${acsUrl}"
      index="0"
      isDefault="true"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>`;
}
async function federatedLogin(fastify, profile, provider, tenantId, ip, userAgent) {
  const db = fastify.db;
  const { identity, session } = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const existing = await tx.oAuthAccount.findUnique({
      where: {
        provider_providerUserId: {
          provider,
          providerUserId: profile.nameID
        }
      },
      include: { identity: true }
    });
    let resolvedIdentity;
    if (existing) {
      resolvedIdentity = existing.identity;
    } else {
      let newIdentity = profile.email ? await tx.identity.findFirst({
        where: { primaryEmail: profile.email }
      }) : null;
      if (newIdentity && !newIdentity.emailVerified) {
        throw ApiError.conflict(
          "An account with this email already exists but hasn't been verified yet. Please verify your email or sign in with your password first, then link this identity provider from your account settings."
        );
      }
      if (!newIdentity) {
        newIdentity = await tx.identity.create({
          data: {
            primaryEmail: profile.email,
            name: profile.name,
            status: "ACTIVE",
            emailVerified: Boolean(profile.email)
          }
        });
        const memberRole = await tx.role.findFirst({
          where: { tenantId, name: "MEMBER" },
          select: { id: true }
        });
        if (!memberRole) {
          throw ApiError.internal(
            `Failed JIT provisioning: 'MEMBER' role missing for tenant ${tenantId}.`
          );
        }
        await tx.tenantMembership.create({
          data: {
            identityId: newIdentity.id,
            tenantId,
            roleId: memberRole.id,
            status: "ACTIVE"
          }
        });
      }
      await tx.oAuthAccount.create({
        data: {
          identityId: newIdentity.id,
          provider,
          providerUserId: profile.nameID,
          accessToken: generateToken(16)
        }
      });
      resolvedIdentity = newIdentity;
    }
    if (resolvedIdentity.status === "SUSPENDED") {
      throw ApiError.forbidden("Account suspended");
    }
    if (resolvedIdentity.status === "BANNED") {
      throw ApiError.forbidden("Account banned");
    }
    const sessionService = new SessionService(tx);
    const { session: newSession } = await sessionService.create({
      identityId: resolvedIdentity.id,
      ip,
      userAgent: userAgent ?? null,
      authLevel: "aal1"
    });
    return { identity: resolvedIdentity, session: newSession };
  });
  const tokenService = new TokenService();
  const directClientId = config.oauth.directClientId;
  const bundle = await tokenService.issue(
    {
      db: fastify.db,
      tenantId,
      identityId: identity.id,
      requestId: ""
    },
    // Cast if your framework context shape varies from Oauth2 options
    {
      identityId: identity.id,
      clientId: directClientId,
      sessionId: session.id,
      scopes: ["openid", "profile", "email", "offline_access"],
      audience: [directClientId],
      tenantId,
      authLevel: "aal1"
    }
  );
  void auditService.log({
    action: "SESSION_CREATED",
    identityId: identity.id,
    ip,
    metadata: { provider }
  }).catch(() => {
  });
  return presentTokenResponse(bundle);
}

// src/modules/idp/routes/idp.route.ts
init_config2();
async function idpRoute(fastify) {
  fastify.post(
    "/connections",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("ENTERPRISE"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Provider Federation"],
        summary: "Create an IdP federation connection \u2014 SAML2, OIDC, or OAUTH2 (ENTERPRISE)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        body: CreateConnectionSchema,
        response: { 201: z79.object({ success: z79.boolean(), data: z79.any() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const body2 = req.body;
      if (!await hasPermission(
        fastify.db,
        req.identity.id,
        body2.tenantId,
        "idp:manage"
      )) {
        throw ApiError.forbidden("Permission required: idp:manage");
      }
      const connection = await fastify.db.idpConnection.create({
        data: {
          tenantId: body2.tenantId,
          name: body2.name,
          protocol: body2.type,
          enabled: true,
          clientId: body2.clientId ?? null,
          clientSecret: body2.clientSecret ?? null,
          entryPoint: body2.entryPoint ?? null,
          issuer: body2.issuer ?? null,
          cert: body2.cert ?? null,
          metadataUrl: body2.metadataUrl ?? null
        }
      });
      void auditService.log({
        action: "IDP_CONNECTION_CREATED",
        identityId: req.identity.id,
        tenantId: body2.tenantId,
        ip: req.ip,
        metadata: { connectionId: connection.id, type: body2.type }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      const { clientSecret: _, ...safe } = connection;
      return reply.status(201).send({ success: true, data: safe });
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/connections",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("ENTERPRISE"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Provider Federation"],
        summary: "List IdP connections for the active tenant (ENTERPRISE)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        response: {
          200: z79.object({ success: z79.boolean(), data: z79.array(z79.any()) })
        }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const tenantId = req.identity.tenantId;
      if (!tenantId) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "Switch to a tenant context first via POST /auth/context/switch"
        );
      }
      const connections = await fastify.db.idpConnection.findMany({
        where: { tenantId },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }
      });
      const safe = connections.map(({ clientSecret: _, ...c }) => c);
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: safe });
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/connections/:id",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("ENTERPRISE"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Provider Federation"],
        summary: "Get a single IdP connection by ID (ENTERPRISE)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: ConnectionParamsSchema,
        response: { 200: z79.object({ success: z79.boolean(), data: z79.any() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const connection = await fastify.db.idpConnection.findUnique({
        where: { id }
      });
      if (!connection) throw ApiError.notFound("IdP connection not found");
      if (!await hasPermission(
        fastify.db,
        req.identity.id,
        connection.tenantId,
        "idp:manage"
      )) {
        throw ApiError.forbidden("Permission required: idp:manage");
      }
      const { clientSecret: _, ...safe } = connection;
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: safe });
    }
  );
  fastify.patch(
    "/connections/:id",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("ENTERPRISE"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Provider Federation"],
        summary: "Update IdP connection settings (ENTERPRISE)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: ConnectionParamsSchema,
        body: UpdateConnectionSchema,
        response: { 200: z79.object({ success: z79.boolean(), data: z79.any() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const body2 = req.body;
      const existing = await fastify.db.idpConnection.findUnique({
        where: { id }
      });
      if (!existing) throw ApiError.notFound("IdP connection not found");
      if (!await hasPermission(
        fastify.db,
        req.identity.id,
        existing.tenantId,
        "idp:manage"
      )) {
        throw ApiError.forbidden("Permission required: idp:manage");
      }
      const updated = await fastify.db.idpConnection.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          name: body2.name,
          clientId: body2.clientId,
          clientSecret: body2.clientSecret,
          entryPoint: body2.entryPoint,
          issuer: body2.issuer,
          cert: body2.cert,
          metadataUrl: body2.metadataUrl
        }
      });
      void auditService.log({
        action: "IDP_CONNECTION_UPDATED",
        identityId: req.identity.id,
        tenantId: existing.tenantId,
        ip: req.ip,
        metadata: { connectionId: id }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      const { clientSecret: _, ...safe } = updated;
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: safe });
    }
  );
  fastify.delete(
    "/connections/:id",
    {
      preHandler: fastify.auth.requirePlan("ENTERPRISE"),
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Provider Federation"],
        summary: "Remove an IdP connection (ENTERPRISE)",
        security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        params: ConnectionParamsSchema,
        response: { 200: z79.object({ success: z79.boolean() }) }
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { id } = req.params;
      const existing = await fastify.db.idpConnection.findUnique({
        where: { id }
      });
      if (!existing) throw ApiError.notFound("IdP connection not found");
      if (!await hasPermission(
        fastify.db,
        req.identity.id,
        existing.tenantId,
        "idp:manage"
      )) {
        throw ApiError.forbidden("Permission required: idp:manage");
      }
      await fastify.db.idpConnection.delete({ where: { id } });
      void auditService.log({
        action: "IDP_CONNECTION_UPDATED",
        identityId: req.identity.id,
        tenantId: existing.tenantId,
        ip: req.ip,
        metadata: { connectionId: id, action: "deleted" }
      }).catch(() => {
      });
      return reply.send({ success: true });
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/saml/:tenantSlug/metadata",
    {
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Provider Federation"],
        summary: "SAML SP metadata XML \u2014 register this URL in your IdP admin panel",
        params: TenantSlugParamsSchema
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { tenantSlug } = req.params;
      const tenant = await fastify.db.tenant.findFirst({
        where: { slug: tenantSlug },
        select: { id: true }
      });
      if (!tenant) throw ApiError.notFound("Tenant not found");
      const connection = await fastify.db.idpConnection.findFirst({
        where: { tenantId: tenant.id, protocol: "SAML2", enabled: true }
      });
      const xml = connection?.cert && connection?.entryPoint ? generateSamlMetadata(connection, tenantSlug) : generateMinimalSamlMetadata(tenantSlug);
      return reply.type("application/xml").send(xml);
    }
  );
  fastify.post(
    "/saml/:tenantSlug/callback",
    {
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Provider Federation"],
        summary: "SAML assertion consumer service \u2014 called by the external IdP after login",
        params: TenantSlugParamsSchema
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { tenantSlug } = req.params;
      const body2 = req.body;
      if (!body2?.SAMLResponse) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest("Missing SAMLResponse in POST body");
      }
      const tenant = await fastify.db.tenant.findFirst({
        where: { slug: tenantSlug },
        select: { id: true }
      });
      if (!tenant) throw ApiError.notFound("Tenant not found");
      const connection = await fastify.db.idpConnection.findFirst({
        where: { tenantId: tenant.id, protocol: "SAML2", enabled: true }
      });
      if (!connection) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "No active SAML2 IdP connection for this tenant"
        );
      }
      const saml = buildSamlInstance(connection, tenantSlug);
      let profile;
      try {
        profile = await saml.validatePostResponseAsync(body2);
      } catch (err) {
        throw ApiError.unauthorized(
          `SAML assertion validation failed: ${err.message}`
        );
      }
      const nameID = profile.profile?.nameID;
      if (!nameID) throw ApiError.badRequest("SAML assertion missing NameID");
      const email = profile.profile?.["http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress"] ?? profile.profile?.email ?? null;
      const name = profile.profile?.["http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/name"] ?? profile.profile?.displayName ?? null;
      const tokenData = await federatedLogin(
        fastify,
        { nameID, email, name },
        `saml:${connection.id}`,
        tenant.id,
        req.ip,
        req.headers["user-agent"]
      );
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: tokenData });
    }
  );
  fastify.get(
    "/oidc/:tenantSlug/callback",
    {
      schema: {
        tags: ["Identity Provider Federation"],
        summary: "OIDC federation callback \u2014 called by the external IdP after login",
        params: TenantSlugParamsSchema,
        querystring: OidcCallbackQuerySchema
      }
    },
    async (req, reply) => {
      const { tenantSlug } = req.params;
      const { code, error, error_description } = req.query;
      if (error) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          `IdP error: ${error}${error_description ? ` \u2014 ${error_description}` : ""}`
        );
      }
      if (!code) throw ApiError.badRequest("Missing authorization code");
      const tenant = await fastify.db.tenant.findFirst({
        where: { slug: tenantSlug },
        select: { id: true }
      });
      if (!tenant) throw ApiError.notFound("Tenant not found");
      const connection = await fastify.db.idpConnection.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId: tenant.id,
          protocol: { in: ["OIDC", "OAUTH2"] },
          enabled: true
        }
      });
      if (!connection) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "No active OIDC/OAuth2 IdP connection for this tenant"
        );
      }
      if (!connection.clientId || !connection.clientSecret) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "IdP connection is missing clientId or clientSecret"
        );
      }
      const discoveryUrl = connection.metadataUrl ?? (connection.issuer ? `${connection.issuer}/.well-known/openid-configuration` : null);
      if (!discoveryUrl) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "IdP connection requires metadataUrl or issuer for OIDC"
        );
      }
      const discoveryResp = await fetch(discoveryUrl);
      if (!discoveryResp.ok) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest("Failed to fetch OIDC discovery document");
      }
      const discovery = await discoveryResp.json();
      if (!discovery.token_endpoint || !discovery.jwks_uri || !discovery.issuer) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest(
          "OIDC discovery document is missing required fields (token_endpoint, jwks_uri, issuer)"
        );
      }
      const callbackUrl = `${config.base.apiUrl}/api/v1/idp/oidc/${tenantSlug}/callback`;
      assertSafeUrl(discovery.token_endpoint);
      const tokenResp = await fetch(discovery.token_endpoint, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
        body: new URLSearchParams({
          grant_type: "authorization_code",
          code,
          redirect_uri: callbackUrl,
          client_id: connection.clientId,
          client_secret: connection.clientSecret
        })
      });
      if (!tokenResp.ok) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest("Token exchange with IdP failed");
      }
      const tokens2 = await tokenResp.json();
      if (!tokens2.id_token) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest("IdP did not return an id_token");
      }
      await assertSafeUrl(discovery.jwks_uri);
      const JWKS = createRemoteJWKSet2(new URL(discovery.jwks_uri));
      let claims;
      try {
        const { payload } = await jwtVerify3(tokens2.id_token, JWKS, {
          issuer: discovery.issuer,
          audience: connection.clientId
        });
        claims = payload;
      } catch (err) {
        throw ApiError.unauthorized(
          `id_token verification failed: ${err.message ?? "invalid signature or claims"}`
        );
      }
      const sub = claims.sub;
      if (!sub) {
        throw ApiError.badRequest("Verified id_token is missing sub claim");
      }
      const tokenData = await federatedLogin(
        fastify,
        {
          nameID: sub,
          email: claims.email ?? null,
          name: claims.name ?? null
        },
        `oidc:${connection.id}`,
        tenant.id,
        req.ip,
        req.headers["user-agent"]
      );
      return reply.send({ success: true, data: tokenData });
    }
  );
}

// src/api/server/build-server.ts
async function buildServer() {
  const server = Fastify({
    logger: config.base.isProduction ? { level: config.base.logLevel } : {
      transport: {
        target: "pino-pretty",
        options: { colorize: true }
      }
    }
  });
  server.setValidatorCompiler(validatorCompiler);
  server.setSerializerCompiler(serializerCompiler);
  await server.register(helmet, {
    contentSecurityPolicy: {
      directives: {
        defaultSrc: ["'none'"],
        scriptSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"],
        // Swagger UI bundle loader
        styleSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"],
        // Swagger UI inline styles
        imgSrc: ["'self'", "data:"],
        // Swagger UI icons
        fontSrc: ["'self'"],
        connectSrc: ["'self'"],
        frameSrc: ["'none'"],
        objectSrc: ["'none'"],
        baseUri: ["'self'"],
        formAction: ["'self'"],
        frameAncestors: ["'none'"],
        ...config.base.isProduction ? { upgradeInsecureRequests: [] } : {}
      }
    },
    strictTransportSecurity: config.base.isProduction ? { maxAge: 31536e3, includeSubDomains: true } : false,
    frameguard: { action: "deny" },
    noSniff: true,
    referrerPolicy: { policy: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" },
    dnsPrefetchControl: { allow: false },
    permittedCrossDomainPolicies: { permittedPolicies: "none" },
    crossOriginResourcePolicy: { policy: "same-origin" },
    crossOriginOpenerPolicy: { policy: "same-origin" }
  });
  await server.register(cors, {
    origin: config.base.allowedOrigins,
    credentials: true,
    methods: ["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"],
    allowedHeaders: [
      "Content-Type",
      "Authorization",
      "X-Idempotency-Key",
      "X-Request-ID"
    ],
    exposedHeaders: ["X-Request-ID", "Retry-After"]
  });
  await server.register(underPressure, {
    maxEventLoopDelay: 1e3,
    maxHeapUsedBytes: 1e9,
    exposeStatusRoute: "/health/pressure"
  });
  await server.register(cookie, {
    secret: config.security.cookieSecret,
    parseOptions: {}
  });
  await server.register(dbPlugin);
  await server.register(jwtPlugin);
  await server.register(authGuardPlugin);
  await server.register(rateLimitPlugin);
  await server.register(swaggerGeneratorPlugin);
  server.setErrorHandler(errorHandler);
  await server.register(healthRoute);
  await server.register(openIdConfigurationRoute);
  await server.register(didDocumentRoute);
  if (!config.base.isProduction) {
    await server.register(mailPreviewRoute);
  }
  await server.register(
    async (api) => {
      await api.register(authPlugin);
      await api.register(oauthPlugin);
      await api.register(identityPlugin);
      await api.register(tenantPlugin);
      await api.register(credentialsPlugin);
      await api.register(billingPlugin);
      await api.register(auditPlugin);
      await api.register(webhooksPlugin);
      await api.register(idpPlugin);
    },
    { prefix: "/api/v1" }
  );
  await server.register(swaggerUiPlugin);
  return server;
}

// src/api/server/start-server.ts
init_config2();
async function start() {
  let serverInstance = null;
  let isFullyBooted = false;
  process.on("unhandledRejection", (reason) => {
    if (serverInstance) {
      serverInstance.log.error({ reason }, "Unhandled promise rejection");
    } else {
      console.error("[SERVER] Unhandled rejection during startup:", reason);
    }
    if (!isFullyBooted) {
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });
  process.on("uncaughtException", (err) => {
    if (serverInstance) {
      serverInstance.log.fatal({ err }, "Uncaught exception error");
    } else {
      console.error("[SERVER] Uncaught exception:", err);
    }
    process.exit(1);
  });
  const server = await buildServer();
  serverInstance = server;
  const shutdown = async (signal) => {
    server.log.info(
      { signal },
      "Shutdown signal received \u2014 draining connections"
    );
    try {
      await server.close();
      server.log.info("Server closed cleanly");
      process.exit(0);
    } catch (err) {
      server.log.error({ err }, "Error during shutdown");
      process.exit(1);
    }
  };
  process.on("SIGINT", () => void shutdown("SIGINT"));
  process.on("SIGTERM", () => void shutdown("SIGTERM"));
  process.on("SIGQUIT", () => void shutdown("SIGQUIT"));
  try {
    await server.listen({ host: "0.0.0.0", port: config.base.port });
    isFullyBooted = true;
    server.log.info(`ArcID Engine ready on port ${config.base.port}`);
    server.log.info(`Swagger UI  \u2192 http://localhost:${config.base.port}/docs`);
    if (!config.base.isProduction) {
      server.log.info(
        `Mail Preview \u2192 http://localhost:${config.base.port}/mail/preview`
      );
    }
  } catch (err) {
    server.log.error({ err }, "Failed to start server network listener");
    process.exit(1);
  }
}
void start();

This caused every upsert on a REQUIRED_TENANT_MODEL\n * to throw TENANT_ISOLATION_VIOLATION even when tenantId was correctly supplied\n * in args.create.\n */\nfunction extractTenantId(action: string, The auth-guard\n//   checks this table on every authenticated request via a point-lookup.\n//\n//   At scale this has two problems:\n//     1. DB round-trip on every single request — high-frequency read on a\n//        table that grows until the cleanup job runs.\n//     2. The cleanup job only purges JTIs older than 7 days, but access\n//        tokens expire in 15 minutes. We're retaining revocation records\n//        14.96 days longer than necessary.\n//\n// SOLUTION:\n//   Promote the JTI check to Redis (Upstash) with a TTL equal to the access\n//   token's remaining lifetime. Redis O(1) GET vs a DB indexed lookup.\n//   The DB RevokedJti table remains as the durable fallback — useful for\n//   audit and for the window between Redis expiry and DB cleanup.\n//\n// INTEGRATION:\n//   1. Call `blockJti(jti, ttlSeconds)` when revoking an access token.\n//   2. rules: PasswordRules | null | undefined,\n): string[] {\n  if (!rules) return [];\n  const errors: string[] = [];\n\n  if (rules.minLength && password.length < rules.minLength) {\n attackers rotate IPs to bypass per-IP rate limits\n//   while trying many passwords against one account. The per-IP rate limit\n//   on the login route (10/min) stops naive single-IP attacks. This module\n//   adds a second layer: per-EMAIL failed attempt counting that survives\n//   IP rotation.\n//\n// DESIGN:\n//   - Email is hashed (SHA-256) before use as a Redis key — we never store\n//     plaintext emails in Redis.\n//   - Two keys per email:\n//       arcid:login_fail:{emailHash}    — attempt counter, TTL resets on each failure\n//       arcid:login_lock:{emailHash}    — lockout sentinel, TTL is the lockout duration\n//   - On failure:  increment counter → set lockout key if threshold crossed\n//   - On success:  clear both keys\n//   - On check:    if lockout key createHash } from \"crypto\";\nimport { config } from \"@/core/config\";\nimport { logger } from \"@/lib/logger\";\n\n// ── Redis (lazy, same pattern as jti-blocklist.ts) (h: string) => `arcid:login_lock:${h}`;\n\n// ── Lockout thresholds ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunction lockoutTtlSeconds(attempts: number): number | null {\n  if (attempts >= 20) return 86_400; // 24 hours\n  if (attempts >= 10) return 3_600; // 1 hour\n  if (attempts >= 5) return 900; // 15 minutes\n  return null;\n}\n\n// ── Public API getRedis();\n  if (!r) return;\n\n  try {\n    const h = emailHash(email);\n    const fk = failKey(h);\n    const lk = lockKey(h);\n    const WINDOW = 15 * 60; // 15-minute sliding window for the This was a silent correctness bug.\n//   - Each challenge is assigned a UUID (challengeId) returned to the caller.\n//     Routes can cross-check this ID during verification for extra ceremony binding.\n//   - Redis consume uses GETDEL — a single atomic command.\n//     The old get() + del() pattern had a race window: if two requests arrived\n//     simultaneously, both could receive the same challenge before either deleted it.\n//   - TTLs are ceremony-specific (registration is longer; authentication shorter).\n//   - In-memory fallback is safe within a single Node.js process (event loop is\n//     single-threaded). NOT safe across multiple processes — use Redis in production.\nimport { randomUUID } from \"crypto\";\nimport { config } from \"@/core/config\";\nimport { logger } from \"@/lib/logger\";\n\n// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport type CeremonyType = \"registration\" | \"authentication\";\n\nexport interface StoredChallenge {\n  /** Opaque ID you can bind to the ceremony — pass back to consumeChallenge for verification. */\n  challengeId: string;\n  challenge: string;\n}\n\ninterface ChallengeEntry extends StoredChallenge {\n  expiresAt: number;\n}\n\n// ── Config ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/** TTL in seconds per ceremony type. Registration gives more time for device prompts. */\nconst TTL_SEC: Record<CeremonyType, number> = {\n  registration: 120, // 2 minutes\n  authentication: 90, // 1.5 minutes\n};\n\n// ── Key scheme ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Previous scheme: `passkey:challenge:${identityId}`\n// New scheme:      `passkey:challenge:${ceremony}:${identityId}`\n// Ceremony is part of the key, so registration and auth challenges are isolated.\nconst challengeKey = (identityId: string, ceremony: CeremonyType): string =>\n  `passkey:challenge:${ceremony}:${identityId}`;\n\n// ── In-memory fallback ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Keyed by the full challengeKey string (includes ceremony type).\nconst memStore = new Map<string, ChallengeEntry>();\n\n// ── Lazy Redis init ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nlet _redis: import(\"@upstash/redis\").Redis | null = null;\n\nasync function getRedis(): Promise<import(\"@upstash/redis\").Redis | null> {\n  if (!config.redis.enabled) return null;\n  if (_redis) return _redis;\n\n  try {\n    const { Redis } = await import(\"@upstash/redis\");\n    _redis = new Redis({ url: config.redis.url!, token: config.redis.token! });\n    return _redis;\n  } catch (err) {\n    logger.error(\n      { err },\n      \"[CHALLENGE_STORE] Redis init failed — falling back to memory\",\n    );\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\n// ── Public API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * Store a WebAuthn challenge for a given user and ceremony type.\n * Overwrites any existing challenge for this (identityId, ceremony) pair.\n * Returns a challengeId that can be bound to the WebAuthn options object.\n */\nexport async function storeChallenge(\n  identityId: string,\n  ceremony: CeremonyType,\n  challenge: string,\n): Promise<StoredChallenge> {\n  const challengeId = randomUUID();\n  const ttl = TTL_SEC[ceremony];\n  const k = challengeKey(identityId, ceremony);\n  const entry: ChallengeEntry = {\n    challengeId,\n    challenge,\n    expiresAt: Date.now() + ttl * 1000,\n  };\n\n  const r = await getRedis();\n\n  if (r) {\n    await r.set(k, JSON.stringify(entry), { ex: ttl });\n  } else {\n    memStore.set(k, entry);\n    logger.warn(\n      { identityId, string,\n  ceremony: CeremonyType,\n): Promise<StoredChallenge | null> {\n  const k = challengeKey(identityId, ceremony);\n  const r = await getRedis();\n\n  if (r) {\n    // GETDEL: atomically  { err, identityId, ceremony },\n        \"[CHALLENGE_STORE] Failed to parse stored challenge\",\n      );\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // In-memory path: get + delete is safe here logger.warn(\n      { identityId, ceremony },\n      \"[CHALLENGE_STORE] Challenge expired\",\n    );\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  return { challengeId: entry.challengeId, challenge: entry.challenge };\n}\n\n// ── Dev utility ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/** Flush all in-memory challenges. Step-Up Elevation\n//\n// Problem in previous version:\n//   The verify() method executed:\n//     1. verifyPassword/verifyTotp/verifyPasskey()  ← credential check\n//     2. db.session.update({ elevatedAt: new Date() })  ← elevation write\n//\n//   These are two separate DB round-trips with no atomicity guarantee. Under\n//   concurrent requests (e.g. a user double-submitting the step-up form):\n//     - Both requests pass step 1 (credential check is stateless / read-only).\n//     - Both write elevatedAt independently — no harm today, but in a future\n//       distributed deployment with a Redis elevation cache, this race window\n//       could allow two elevation tokens to be generated simultaneously with\n//       mismatched expiry windows.\n//\n//   Additionally, the elevation write did not validate that the session was\n//   still valid and unexpired at the moment of writing — a session that expired\n//   during the async credential check could still be elevated.\n//\n// Fix:\n//   The session update now uses a conditional WHERE clause:\n//     WHERE id = $sessionId AND valid = true AND expiresAt > now()\n//   This is enforced via Prisma's updateMany (returns count). If count = 0,\n//   the session expired or was revoked between the route-level check and the\n//   elevation write — we fail with 403 rather than silently elevating a dead\n//   session.\n//\n//   This makes elevation idempotent-safe: a second concurrent request that\n//   passes credential verification will still write elevatedAt (which is\n//   benign — it's the same value ± ms), but the WHERE guard ensures it only\n//   succeeds against a live session.\n//\n// Supported re-auth methods:\n//   - password  (always available on local accounts)\n//   - totp      (when MFA is enabled)\n//   - passkey   (when a passkey is registered)\n\nimport type { DbClient } from \"@/lib/db-client\";\nimport { ApiError } from \"@/core/errors\";\nimport { verifyPassword } from StepUpService {\n  constructor(private readonly db: DbClient) {}\n\n  async verify(input: StepUpInput): Promise<void> {\n    // ── Step 1: Verify the credential (stateless / read-only) ─────────────────\n    // All verifiers throw ApiError on failure — nothing is mutated here.\n    switch (input.method) {\n      case \"password\":\n        await this.#verifyPassword(input);\n        break;\n      case \"totp\":\n        await this.#verifyTotp(input);\n        break;\n      case \"passkey\":\n        await this.#verifyPasskey(input);\n        break;\n      default:\n        throw ApiError.badRequest(\"Unsupported step-up method\");\n    }\n\n    // ── Step 2: Atomic conditional elevation write ────────────────────────────\n    // Use updateMany with a WHERE guard so the elevation only lands on a session\n    // that is still live at the exact moment of the write.\n    //\n    // The WHERE conditions mirror the route-level check in step-up.route.ts\n    // (valid = true, expiresAt > now, identityId matches) but re-applied here\n    // inside the service to close the TOCTOU window between the route guard and\n    // this write. If the session was revoked or expired in the interim, count = 0\n    // and we fail rather than elevating a dead session.\n    const elevatedAt = new Date();\n\n    const { count } = await this.db.session.updateMany({\n      where: {\n        id: input.sessionId,\n        identityId: input.identityId, // ownership re-check at write time\n        valid: true,\n        expiresAt: { gt: new Date() },\n      },\n      data: {\n        authLevel: \"aal2\",\n        elevatedAt,\n      },\n    });\n\n    if (count === 0) {\n      // Session expired or was revoked between the route-level check and here.\n      // This is not a credential failure — it's a session state failure.\n      throw ApiError.forbidden(\n        \"Session expired or was revoked during step-up — please log in again\",\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ── Private verifiers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  // Each verifier only reads — no mutations. step-up method 'password'\",\n      );\n    }\n\n    const localAccount = await this.db.localAccount.findUnique({\n      where: { identityId: input.identityId },\n      select: { passwordHash: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!localAccount) {\n      throw ApiError.badRequest(\n        \"No local account found — use a different step-up method\",\n      );\n    }\n\n    const valid = await verifyPassword(\n      localAccount.passwordHash,\n      input.password,\n    );\n    if (!valid) {\n      throw ApiError.unauthorized(\"Incorrect password\");\n    }\n  }\n\n  async #verifyTotp(input: StepUpInput): Promise<void> {\n    if (!input.totpCode) {\n      throw ApiError.badRequest(\n        \"totpCode is required for step-up method 'totp'\",\n      );\n    }\n\n string {\n  // Count leading zero bytes — each becomes a \"1\" in the output.\n  // Then skip them in the conversion loop so they aren't double-counted\n  // (otherwise a zero byte also produces digit 0 → \"1\").\n  let leadingZeros = 0;\n  while (leadingZeros < bytes.length && bytes[leadingZeros] === 0) {\n    leadingZeros++;\n  }\n\n  const body = bytes.slice(leadingZeros);\n  if (body.length === 0) return \"1\".repeat(leadingZeros);\n\n  // Convert non-zero body to big-endian base-58\n  const digits: number[] = [0];\n  for (const b of body) {\n    let carry = b;\n    for (let j = 0; j < digits.length; j++) {\n      carry += digits[j] << 8;\n      digits[j] = carry % 58;\n      carry = (carry / 58) | 0;\n    }\n    while (carry) {\n      digits.push(carry % 58);\n      carry = (carry / 58) | 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Leading zeros become \"1\" prefix characters\n  const parts: string[] = new Array(leadingZeros).fill(\"1\");\n  for (let i = digits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\n    parts.push(BASE58_ALPHABET[digits[i]]);\n  }\n  return parts.join(\"\");\n}\n\n/**\n * Encode raw bytes as multibase base58btc with \"z\" prefix.\n * This is the canonical `publicKeyMultibase` Use JWT or SD_JWT.`,\n        );\n      default:\n        throw ApiError.badRequest(`Unknown VcFormat: ${format}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ── JWT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n  private async signJwt(\n    payload: Record<string, unknown>,\n    issuerDid: string,\n  ): Promise<{ proof: string; signedCredential: string }> {\n    const signingKey = await this.loadSigningKey(issuerDid);\n\n    // Decrypt the private key — key material exists in memory only for\n    // the duration of this sign operation.\n    const decrypted = await decryptPrivateKey(signingKey);\n    const pemKey = this.derToPem(decrypted, \"PRIVATE KEY\");\n    const privateKey = await importPKCS8(pemKey, signingKey.algorithm);\n\n    const jwt = await new SignJWT({ vc: payload })\n      .setProtectedHeader({ alg: signingKey.algorithm, kid: signingKey.kid })\n      .setIssuer(issuerDid)\n      .setIssuedAt()\n      .sign(privateKey);\n\n    return { proof: jwt, signedCredential: jwt };\n  }\n\n  // ── SD-JWT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n  private async signSdJwt(\n    payload: Record<string, unknown>,\n    issuerDid: string,\n  ): Promise<{ proof: string; signedCredential: string }> {\n    const signingKey = await this.loadSigningKey(issuerDid);\n\n    // Decrypt the private key — key material exists in memory only for\n    // the duration of this sign operation.\n    const decrypted = await decryptPrivateKey(signingKey);\n    // SdJwtService.sign() accepts a PEM string directly and imports it internally.\n    const pemKey = this.derToPem(decrypted, \"PRIVATE KEY\");\n\n    // All credentialSubject fields except \"id\" are selectively disclosable\n    // by default. Pass an explicit list here to restrict which fields are SD.\n    const sdJwtService = new SdJwtService();\n    const sdJwt = await sdJwtService.sign(\n      payload,\n      pemKey,\n      [], // empty = default disclosure: all credentialSubject fields except \"id\"\n      signingKey.algorithm,\n    );\n\n    return { proof: sdJwt, signedCredential: sdJwt };\n  }\n\n  // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n  private async loadSigningKey(issuerDid: string) {\n    const did = await this.db.decentralizedIdentifier.findUnique({\n      where: { id: issuerDid },\n    });\n\n    if (!did) {\n      throw ApiError.notFound(`DID not found: ${issuerDid}`);\n    }\n\n    if (!did.tenantId) {\n      // did.identityId is set instead — an individually-owned DID\n      // registered via the wallet-did flow in identity/modules.\n      //\n      // This is a permanent guard, not a pending feature gap. ArcID is\n      // expressly non-custodial for individual DIDs: ArcWallet generates\n      // and holds the private key on-device. Private IPv6 ranges (loopback, ULA, link-local)\n//   - Cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254, etc.)\n//   - Non-HTTP(S) schemes\n//   - Hostnames that RESOLVE to any of the above\n//\n// FIX: the A\n// hostname like \"attacker-controlled.example.com\" that DNS-resolves to\n// 169.254.169.254 or 127.0.0.1 sailed straight through the old checks,\n// then fetch() connected to whatever it actually resolved to. 1) / 2;\n      const xBytes = raw.subarray(1, 1 + pointLen);\n      const yBytes = raw.subarray(1 + pointLen);\n\n      let crv: string;\n      let alg: string;\n      if (pointLen === 32) {\n        crv = \"P-256\";\n        alg = \"ES256\";\n      } else if (pointLen === 48) {\n        crv = \"P-384\";\n        alg = \"ES384\";\n      } else if (pointLen === 66) {\n        crv = \"P-521\";\n        alg = \"ES512\";\n      } else {\n        throw new Error(`Unsupported EC key length: ${pointLen} bytes`);\n      }\n\n      const x = Buffer.from(xBytes).toString(\"base64url\");\n      const y = Buffer.from(yBytes).toString(\"base64url\");\n      return importJWK({ kty: \"EC\", crv, x, y }, alg) as Promise<CryptoKey>;\n    }\n\n    default:\n      throw new Error(\n        `Unsupported key type for proof verification: ${keyType}`,\n      );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Verify a detached JWS proof.\n *\n * @param proof                  - Convert stored public key bytes to a CryptoKey\n    const publicKey = await didKeyToPublicKey(did.publicKeyBytes, did.keyType);\n\n    // 3. Reconstruct the complete JWS token using the detached payload\n    const payloadBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(\n      JSON.stringify({ credentialHash: expectedCredentialHash }),\n    );\n    const payloadB64u = base64url.encode(payloadBytes);\n\n    const parts = proof.split(\".\");\n    if (parts.length !== 3) return false;\n\n    // Inject the base64url payload into the missing middle slot (\"header..signature\")\n    const fullJws = `${parts[0]}.${payloadB64u}.${parts[2]}`;\n\n    // 4. var envSchema = z.object({
  NODE_ENV: z.enum(["development", "production", "test"]).default("development"),
  LOG_LEVEL: z.string().default("info"),
  PORT: z.coerce.number().default(4e3),

  // Key Management Service (KMS) Infrastructure Secrets
  KMS_PROVIDER: z.enum(["AWS", "GCP", ""]).optional().default(""),
  AWS_KMS_KEY_ID: z.string().optional(),
  GCP_KMS_KEY_NAME: z.string().optional(),
  LOCAL_KMS_KEY: z.string().optional(),
  // Cookie Secret
  COOKIE_SECRET: z.string().min(32, "COOKIE_SECRET must be at least 32 characters"),
  // ── RSA/EC Key Pair for RS256 token signing (optional) ─────────────────
  PRIVATE_KEY_PEM: z.string().default(""),
  PUBLIC_KEY_PEM: z.string().default("")
}).superRefine((data, ctx) => {
  if (data.KMS_PROVIDER === "AWS" && !data.AWS_KMS_KEY_ID) {
    ctx.addIssue({
      code: "custom",
      message: "AWS_KMS_KEY_ID required when KMS_PROVIDER is AWS",
      path: ["AWS_KMS_KEY_ID"]
    });
  }
  if (data.KMS_PROVIDER === "GCP" && !data.GCP_KMS_KEY_NAME) {
    ctx.addIssue({
      code: "custom",
      message: "GCP_KMS_KEY_NAME required when KMS_PROVIDER is GCP",
      path: ["GCP_KMS_KEY_NAME"]
    });
  }
  if (!data.KMS_PROVIDER && !data.LOCAL_KMS_KEY && data.NODE_ENV === "production") {
    ctx.addIssue({
      code: "custom",
      message: "LOCAL_KMS_KEY is required in production when no KMS_PROVIDER is set",
      path: ["LOCAL_KMS_KEY"]
    });
  }
});

var ApiError = class _ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(message, statusCode, code) {
    super(message);
    this.statusCode = statusCode;
    this.code = code ?? `HTTP_${statusCode}`;
    this.name = "ApiError";
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, _ApiError.prototype);
  }
  // ── HTTP helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  static badRequest(msg) {
    return new _ApiError(msg, 400, "BAD_REQUEST");
  }

// src/core/db/tenant-isolation.ts
var REQUIRED_TENANT_MODELS = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([
  "TenantBranding",
  "TenantSigningKey",
  "IdpConnection",
  "Role",
  "TenantMembership",
  "Project",
  "TenantPolicy",
  "WebhookEndpoint"
]);
var OPTIONAL_TENANT_MODELS = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([
  "Client",
  "AccessDelegation",
  "AuditLog",
  "WebhookEvent",
  "Subscription"
]);
var WRITE_ACTIONS = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([
  "create",
  "createMany",
  "update",
  "updateMany",
  "upsert"
]);
function extractTenantId(action, args) {
  if (!args) return void 0;
  switch (action) {
    case "createMany": {
      const data = args.data;
      if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) return data[0].tenantId;
      return void 0;
    }
    case "upsert":
      return args.create?.tenantId ?? args.update?.tenantId;
    default:
      return args.data?.tenantId;
  }
}
function hasTenantId(value) {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0;
}
function withTenantIsolation(client) {
  return client.$extends({
    query: {
      $allModels: {
        async $allOperations({ model, operation, args, query }) {
          if (!WRITE_ACTIONS.has(operation)) return query(args);
          const isRequired = REQUIRED_TENANT_MODELS.has(model ?? "");
          const isOptional = OPTIONAL_TENANT_MODELS.has(model ?? "");
          if (!isRequired && !isOptional) return query(args);
          const tenantIdValue = extractTenantId(operation, args);
          if (isRequired && !hasTenantId(tenantIdValue)) {
            throw new ApiError(
              `[TenantIsolation] ${operation} on ${model} requires tenantId in data payload. Got: ${JSON.stringify(tenantIdValue)}. This is a server-side programming error \u2014 the route or flow must supply tenantId.`,
              500,
              "TENANT_ISOLATION_VIOLATION"
            );
          }
          if (isOptional && !hasTenantId(tenantIdValue) && process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
            console.warn(
              `[TenantIsolation] ${operation} on ${model} has no tenantId. If this is a system-level record, this is expected. If it belongs to a tenant, add tenantId to the data payload.`
            );
          }
          return query(args);
        }
      }
    }
  });
}
